Note:
Encounter Phases:
Regroup - Take a ship from warp
Destiny - Draw from destiny deck
Launch - Aim gate and commit 1-4 ships
Alliance - Offense/Defense ask, allies choose
Planning - Main encounter cards are chosen
Reveal - Effects and totals are calculated
Resolution -  Place ships and discard cards
Second Encounter possible if Offense wins

Getting Cards:
Defending allies get rewards for each ship
Negotiate for cards from the other player
Compensation for negotiating while attacked

Drawing new hand:
Start Turn without Encounter cards
Defend without Encounter cards at Planning

 Extra:
Can only play one flare per encounter
Power lost when 3 home colonies are gone
Ships can only move when sent or returned
Ships can only return to existing colonies
Last Destiny card is not drawn but reshuffled

0.title: Rules
0.body:
[b]- Cosmic Encounter -[/b][/u]

Eons ago, your ancestors searched the black void of space for intelligent life. The search proved fruitless; they were alone. Desolate, they used their technology to send the seeds of life to inhabitable planets. They waited, but gradually over the millennia they faded into nothingness. However, over millions of years, alien races slowly evolved. 

To aid their children, your ancestors left behind a legacy of advanced technology and hyperspace gates. They meant these gifts to encourage communication and harmony between their children. Now, without the guiding touch of an elder hand, you and your distant alien cousins must learn to communicate, negotiate, and coexist. 

[b]Welcome to the Cosmic Age[/b]

The open skies of countless worlds are filled with speeding spaceships, and a panoply of lien races is competing to populate the galaxy. Will your own people choose to occupy undefended worlds, create peaceful and diverse alien civilizations, or ruthlessly conquer others' territory? 
In the quest to colonize as many planets as possible, there are as many paths to victory as there are alien races seeking it. 

Peace, war, negotiation, betrayal — you never know what will happen in the next encounter.

[b]- Additional Rulebooks -[/b][/u]

1.title: Summary
1.body:
[b] Basic summary [/b] 

overview of the game, theme, and how to win
encounters step by step
the alien powers and flares
any other cards (artifacts)
how you get a new hand (it's kind of a weird rule compared to other games)
A more detailed guide:

[b] Intro [/b]

Set up first, so they can see the warp, their planets and colonies. Don't hand out cards, flares or aliens yet.
Give an overview of the game, something like "We are each an alien race, trying to conquer each other's planets. Each one of these stacks of your ships is a colony - if you can get colonies on 5 planets that aren't your own, you win."
"The game takes place over a series of encounters - on your turn, you have an encounter with one player. If you beat them, you can choose to have a second encounter."

[b] Encounters [/b]

Regroup/destiny/launch - pretty simple to explain. "Take one of your ships from the warp (if you have one), then flip the top card of the destiny deck. This is who you will encounter this turn. Pick one of their colonies on one of their planets, point the cone at it and put in 1-4 ships. "
Alliance - remember that offense asks first, then defense, and ONLY THEN can players (starting from the left of the offense and going clockwise) accept an offer and commit ships (1-4 each), or refuse.
Planning - describe the 3 types of encounter cards (attack/negotiate/morph). Make sure you cover how negotiates work in detail, as that can be a bit tricky for first-time players, especially compensation (new players often get this confused with defender rewards).
Reveal - higher total wins; defense wins on ties; N against attacks = instant lose + compensation; N against N = 1 minute deal, a trade must be made (no non-binding agreements!). Also explain reinforcements, and say they can be played at this point.
Resolution - Losing side (including allies) go to warp, winning offense moves onto planet, winning defense gets nothing (but allies get rewards).

[b] Aliens [/b]

If everyone understands how an encounter works, move on to alien powers!
"Each one of us is a different alien with a different power, which all break the rules of the game in some way." Briefly explain some of the aliens so they get an idea of what kind of things they can do.
Show them an alien sheet, pointing out the relevant parts - the description, the timing, and whether the power is mandatory/optional.
Explain that alien powers can be 'turned off' if you lose 3/5 of your own planets.
A note here: I would recommend playing with only the green aliens for a first-timer's game. The aliens are mostly balanced, but they assume a certain level of knowledge about the game.

[b] Other cards [/b]

Artifacts - Emphasise that artifacts can only be used when the timing indicator says they can e.g. you can't Mobius Tubes mid-encounter or use Plague after destiny has been drawn. Cosmic Zap can be especially tricky, so point out that each alien says use/may use at a very specific point, and that is when you can zap them.
Flares - "If you get the Flare of your alien, you can only use the Super part. If the flare isn't your alien's, you can only use the Wild part. One flare per encounter, and you can't use the same one twice per encounter." Again, emphasise the specific timing of each card, and that you keep flares when they are played (unless specified otherwise).

[b] Getting a new hand [/b]

It's important that when a player runs out of encounter cards, they don't draw a new hand right away. You don't need to worry about it until it happens, but the rules are:
If you are the offense and you have no encounter cards at the start of your turn, you discard all cards in your hand (playing any first, if you can and want to), then draw 8.
If you are the defense and you have no encounter cards during Planning (when you have to pick a card), you discard all cards in your hand (playing any first, if you can and want to), then draw 8.

[b] Strategy [/b]

My first couple games went over pretty badly because the offense would always ask for allies, making the game really short and unbalanced. Even if you don't like giving tips to new players, I would really emphasise that alliances are a big deal - you're usually helping your allies more than yourself.
If you want to cover some very basic strategy, tell them that hand management is the most important part of the game. If you tell them that the game is similar to poker, they might pick it up easier and be less frustrated in a losing situation.

[b] Variants and expansions [/b]

If you have Cosmic Incursion then IMO the defender rewards deck is a must-have, even in a first-timer's game.
Feel free to mix in all the aliens (but again, just play with green ones).
Anything else (including the techs from the base game) is probably a bit too much until players are more familiar with the game.

2.title: Variants
2.body:
Extra variants along with modifications to those variants.

[b]Base Game[/b]
•Optional second encounter if first was successful.
•One encounter per turn to even game duration
•5 colonies and 20 ships per player
•4 colonies and 16 ships per player for a shorter game

[b]Alliances [/b]
•Use rewards deck for more defender allies.
•Alliances commit ships in clockwise order from the attacker.
•Alliances may commit ships together, unless there are dependencies among players. 
•Hidden alliances with the alliance tool. Players are asked normally, but they decide simulatenously in secret.

[b]Dealing aliens [/b]
•Shuffle 2 powers, choose one. Keep both flares
•Shuffle 3 powers each, choose one alien, Keep 2 flares and discard 1 or deal 1 of each complexity
•New players get all green cards
•Hidden aliens. Reveal when used

[b]Technology [/b]
•Deal 2 cards, choose 1 at start, and discard rest.
•May skip second encounter for new technology. Draw 1+ foreign colonies and keep one. 
•Still draw one if second encounter is not possible.
•Deal 3 cards at random. Players do not get new cards
•Abandoning or completing Tech may transfer trips to another Tech.
•May be offered during a deal

[b]Hazards Deck [/b]
•Draw during hazard warning on destiny card.
•Only second encounters are considered hazard warnings to add more strategy.
•Remove turn reverse (Temporal Anomaly)
•Remove duplicates

[b]Space Stations [/b]
•Deal 1 out to everyone and place on planet.
•Deal 2 if there are 5 or less playing and place on planet.
•Stations are no longer active when the planet is not habited by it's home colony.
•Space stations can be conquered as the result of an encounter. Bring the space station back to a home planet. Alternative win with 5 stations.

[b]Large Group [/b]
•Mix in the many players deck to the cosmic deck if playing with 7 or 8 players.
•Mix in regardless for more random encounters.

[b]Cosmic Stars [/b]
•Each player draws a Cosmic Star at the start of the game. These are placed in your home system. The stars are like a combination of alien power/moon/tech.
•You use the power of your star as long as you have the indicated number of ships in your system. Like the powers, some are mandatory and some are optional.
•Also like the powers, they have a use, which means they are subject to a Cosmic Zap.
•Unlike powers, moons, or tech, the star's power can be used by any player that has the proper number of ships in that system.
•If there's ever a conflict about who gets to use a star's power, the player with more ships gets to use it and the other player(s) do not. If there is a tie, the system owner wins the tie, and the proceeding clockwise from the player.
•Cosmic Stars is like playing with double powers, with some slight variations.

3.title: Aliens
3.body:
These aliens are modified from the cosmodex 2.0 as a rebalance for their powers due to either nullifying other powers, or lacking any significance.

[b]Macochist [/b]
Due to Healer making Masochist's power useless, the Cosmodex suggests giving Masochist the restriction "Do Not Use with Healer."

[b]Healer [/b]
Due to Healer's power being a strong counter to many other aliens, even making some of them nearly or completely useless, the following two house rules are recommended by the Cosmodex:
Healer cannot heal ships that are being removed from the game.
The healed player may choose to leave any or all of his or her healed ships in the warp (this does not prevent Healer from drawing cards).

[b]Locust [/b]
As it is very difficult for Locust to be alone on a planet, especially if the opponents see it coming, the Cosmodex suggests this house rule to make Locust stronger:
Each devoured planet counts as two foreign colonies for Locust instead of one.

[b]Vox [/b]
Because of the limited application of Vox's power (not usable as a defensive ally, and only works on low cards which are unlikely to win an encounter anyway), the Cosmodex suggests these two house rules for Vox:
Vox's power can also be used as a defensive ally.
Vox's power can also be used on a reinforcement card instead to change its value to +11.

[b]Zombie [/b]
According to the Cosmodex, many players feel that Zombie's inability to collect compensation is a significant disadvantage, and suggests a house rule that Zombie is allowed to take compensation based on the number of ships that would go to the warp but saved via Zombie's power.

[b]Brute [/b]
From Jake Reda (game designer and play tester)
For me, this takes the power back to being able to threaten any opposing player, but also tones down the full impact (potentially). The player being threatened can try to bluff the Brute by showing something good early (but not necessarily his or her best encounter card). Brute, can skip over all the good stuff just to get a look at that player's entire hand, but the trade off there is not getting the Attack 30 for example (if it was handed over earlier). In that case, the last card shown might be only an attack 06, which Brute can take, or decide not to bother with (but then the opposing player gets to stay in the encounter, and has not lost anything, or anything good).

4.title: Clarification
4.body:
[b]Alien Zap [/b]
Alien powers can only be zapped when USED, and that power is lost for the remaining encounter. Lost powers consider the alien NOT in play, so that player can use the flare's wild ability, and if it needs to be passed to that alien, it is instead discarded. Similarly to when an alien power is lost to too few home colonies, that alien is not considered in play.

[b]Modified Attack Values [/b]
Revealed cards can be modified to later trigger the revealed effects. Only cards that DIRECTLY influence the resolution outcome can do this, regardless of how the effect is described on the card. When cards are referenced for an effect independant of the current encounter resolution, they are referring to the card ink.

This has caused a lot of debates over the last decade and was resolved in the 2018 FAQ page 4. Personally I think this could have been solved with careful wording on each card, but this is the rule to solve conflicts.
"Unless otherwise specified, game effects that strictly affect encounter resolution—meaning those effects that impact encounter card types/values, kickers, reinforcements, main player totals, the method of determining the winner and loser, deals, compensation, rewards, and disposition of the involved ships such as landing on the planet, returning to colonies, going to the warp, etc.—all refer to the card’s current, modified type/value. Every other kind of game effect refers to the card’s original, printed type/value. Therefore, The Claw does not activate on the Morph card unless an actual Morph card is the claw. Likewise, if the claw is a 12 and the Mirror causes a 21 to turn into a 12, The Claw does not use its power."

[b]Timing Conflicts Rule [/b]
Order of priority
•Offense
•Defense
•Others in clockwise order from offense

Invoke summary
• The earlier player can always invoke the Timing Conflicts rule to go first.
• The later player can invoke the rule to go second if both effects are mandatory.
• Players are not forced to perform, or promise not to perform, optional effects.
• A player with an optional effect can wait for mandatory effects before deciding.
• If neither player wants to use their optional effect first, just move on.

[b]Timing Conflicts Rule Detailed[/b]
In most cases, the sequencing of various game effects in Cosmic Encounter is fairly straightforward. Sometimes, however, two (or more) players want to do conflicting things at the same time. In these cases, the Timing Conflicts rule states that priority goes to the offense, then the defense, and then any other players in clockwise order from the offense. Basically, whichever player is earlier in the Timing Conflicts rule sequence can invoke that rule to go before any players who are later in the sequence.

Both want to go second? It can be unclear to what extent this rule applies in cases were nobody actually wants to go first. Sometimes, such as when an effect can undo or override another effect, it may be preferable to go second; the question then becomes, to what extent can the Timing Conflicts rule actually force somebody to go first? Players are required to perform mandatory effects but are not required to perform optional ones, so answering this question can depend upon the nature of the two conflicting effects themselves.

Both Mandatory:
When both players wish to go second and both of their conflicting effects are mandatory, the "later" player can cite the Timing Conflicts rule in order to go second. This is because both effects are required to happen; both players are forced to initiate them, and if neither wishes to go first then they are essentially forced to initiate them together before the relevant time interval ends. Thus, even if the earlier player doesn't want to go first, the later player can force the Timing Conflicts rule's sequence to be followed; this is the only way to break the logjam. Example: It is the start of Hate's turn. Both Hate and Bandit have mandatory start-of-turn powers that must happen before the Regroup phase begins, and both of these powers can have an impact on Bandit's hand. If neither player cares who goes first, or they both want the same sequence, then the powers can be used in either order. But if they both wish to go first, then Hate (the offense) invokes the rule and gets his way; or if they both wish to go second, then Bandit invokes the rule and gets his way.

One Mandatory, one Optional:
When one of the conflicting effects is mandatory and the other is optional, the player who has the optional effect can simply wait out the other player. He can (in essence) force the player who has the mandatory effect to go first, regardless of roles and seating order. The Timing Conflicts rule does not apply in this case. Since the mandatory effect must happen, that player will be forced to perform it some time before the appropriate time interval ends. Then, the player who has the optional effect can announce that effect and perform it. In other words, the player who has the optional effect is not required to use it in the first place, nor to even commit to whether or not he's going to use it; thus he is not forced to create a "timing conflict" in the first place (although he could, if he wanted to go first and the sequence supported it). When desiring to go second, the player with the optional effect can simply "wait it out" until the coast is clear. The player with the mandatory effect does not have that luxury.

Both Optional:
When both effects are optional and neither player wishes to go first, the game simply moves forward without either player declaring an effect. The later player cannot force the earlier player to use an optional effect against her will, nor does he have the authority to "force a decline" or to "lock her out" from playing her effect later in the same time interval just because she chose not to do so earlier. A player cannot say something like "I want to use my effect as the last effect of the phase"; he can only say "I want to use my effect now." If nobody wants to use an effect now, then simply call a two-second warning and move on to the game's next timing interval. Again, a timing conflict never actually arises because nobody is actually initiating any effect; they are both just sitting there waiting to see what happens. If nothing happens, move on. (If somebody then gives in and performs their action, fine. But the other player then still gets a chance, too.)

House Rule Honor System: 
Sometimes players play cards quickly before the priority player calls their intended action. Although legal, it can sometimes happen TOO quickly for new players, which this is resolved by letting the priority player play their action with the intention of their ORIGINAL goal (not affected by the new information). Example: Someone plagues the offense before the offense was ABOUT to use their Finder artifact, the offense must honor their original intent and not change their target player or target card (such as the offense cannot ask for that plague card knowing which hand it's now in, unless they already knew it was there and was about to specifically ask for it).

5.title: Mod
5.body:
[b]Using this mod [/b]

Once everyone has joined, look to the side table for the colored buttons to start by dealing out the aliens. 
There are additional buttons for adding in other variants such as rewards and hazards. Space stations need to be dealt manually once everyone has selected their aliens.

Aliens with special components and setup will be automatically done by placing the alien sheet on the player tile. 
FULL PHYSICS NEEDS TO BE ON [it is by default]

Any other aliens not chosen can be removed from the game by throwing off the table. Anything that falls off the table will be moved to the void on the side table. Needs full physics to be on.

When ready to start, ensure everyone has done their start game setup and deal out 8 cards from the cosmic deck and tech/stations if appropriate.

To discard cards after use, especially from multiple decks, use the auto-discard button which will affect anything on the table that is face up and will discard them to the appropriate discard deck. Ensure the decks and their respective discards remain in the same place. Needs full physics to be on.

The hidden alliances tool is in everyone's hidden area. Start by clicking alliance and use the arrows to select how many ships for each side. The tool will wait for everyone to commit before printing the choices in the chat.

The cosmic counter is there for calculating complex attacks where many effects will change card values and totals. 
Kicker*(Attack+Value Effects) +Ships+Added Reinforcements
Value effects are those that specify they change the attack value,, otherwise they are simply added reinforcements. For more details see the clarification tab.

To disable the hazard warning, take the token and move it off the direct table. It can be flipped manually this way if desired.

--Activates the highlighting
function onObjectPickUp(_, obj)
    if obj == obj_gate and gateHighlightToggle then
        startLuaCoroutine(Global, 'planetHighlight_routine')
    end
end

--Runs the highlight of the first planet pointed at by the gate
function planetHighlight_routine()
    local startingHeldColor = obj_gate.held_by_color
    while obj_gate.held_by_color ~= nil and obj_gate.held_by_color == startingHeldColor do
        --Escape if toggle is activated during un
        if gateHighlightToggle == false then
            break
        end

        --Find objects in front of tool
        local backDir = obj_gate.getTransformForward()
        local objList =
            Physics.cast(
                {
                    origin = obj_gate.positionToWorld(Vector(0.041, 0, -3.974)),
                    direction = Vector(-backDir.x, 0, -backDir.z),
                    type = 3,
                    size = Vector(0.1, 50, 0.1)
                    --debug=true
                }
            )

        --Remove objects from that list that aren't planets
        local refine_func = function(o)
            return tableContains(ref_planetGUID, o.hit_object.getGUID())
        end
        local planetList = refineTableBy(objList, refine_func)

        --Activate/deactivate highlight (while object is held)
        --print(#planetList)
        if #planetList > 0 then
            --Activate new highlight
            highlightTarget = planetList[1].hit_object
            highlightTarget.highlightOn(Color(1, 0, 0))
            --Deactivate old highlight
            if highlightTarget ~= highlightTarget_old and highlightTarget_old ~= nil then
                highlightTarget_old.highlightOff()
            end
            --Track highlight target for next loop
            highlightTarget_old = highlightTarget
        else
            if highlightTarget_old ~= nil then
                highlightTarget_old.highlightOff()
            end
        end

        wait(0.1)
    end

    --Trigger highlight deactivation
    if highlightTarget ~= nil then
        highlightTarget.highlightOn(Color(1, 0, 0), 2)
    end

    --Clear out values
    highlightTarget = nil
    highlightTarget_old = nil

    return 1
end

--Repeats itself, counting the ships at each location
function shipCounter_routine()
    --Loop over all planets over the course of a second
    for i, zoneGUID in ipairs(ref_planetScriptZoneGUID) do
        local zone = getObjectFromGUID(zoneGUID)
        if zone ~= nil then
            --Establish lish of ships in this zone
            local shipList = getShipList(zone)
            --for k, v in pairs(shipList) do print(k, "  ",v) end --debug

            --Establish display object
            local display = getObjectFromGUID(ref_shipCountDisplayGUID[i])
            if display ~= nil then
                if redrawDisplay(shipList, display) then
                    --Clear and draw new buttons
                    display.clearButtons()
                    createDisplayButtons(display, shipList)
                else
                    --Update buttons already display
                    updateDisplayButtons(display, shipList)
                end
            end
        end

        wait(0.025)
    end

    startLuaCoroutine(Global, 'shipCounter_routine')
    return 1
end

--Creates shipList, which lists the ships in the zone
function getShipList(zone)
    local sort_func = function(o)
        return o.tag == 'Chip'
    end
    local zoneObjList = zone.getObjects()
    local chipList = refineTableBy(zoneObjList, sort_func)

    local shipList = {}
    for _, ship in ipairs(chipList) do
        local shipTint = ship.getColorTint()
        local shipTintName = tintToColorName(shipTint)
        local count = math.abs(ship.getQuantity())
        if shipList[shipTintName] == nil then
            shipList[shipTintName] = count
        else
            shipList[shipTintName] = shipList[shipTintName] + count
        end
    end
    return shipList
end

--Indicates if the # of ships type has changed and requires a redraw
function redrawDisplay(shipList, display)
    local displayButtons = display.getButtons()
    local typeCount_now = 0
    if displayButtons ~= nil then
        typeCount_now = #displayButtons
    end
    local typeCount_new = tableCount(shipList)

    if typeCount_now == typeCount_new then
        return false
    else
        return true
    end
end

--Utility functions

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat
        coroutine.yield(0)
    until os.time() > start + time
end

--Refines a table, only returning entries that match func's requirement
--Example func: function(o) return o.name=="Entry's Name" end
function refineTableBy(t, func)
    if func == nil then
        error('No func supplied to refineTableBy')
    end
    local refinedTable = {}
    local sz = 0
    for _, v in ipairs(t) do
        if func(v) then
            refinedTable[sz + 1] = v
        end
        sz = #refinedTable
    end
    return refinedTable
end

--Check if a table contains a given entry
--Returns true or false, if true it returns the table's key/index
function tableContains(t, target)
    for k, v in pairs(t) do
        if v == target then
            return true, k
        end
    end
    return false
end

--Counts the number of entries in any table type
function tableCount(t)
    local count = 0
    for _ in pairs(t) do
        count = count + 1
    end
    return count
end

--Determines color name based off of tint
function tintToColorName(tint)
    local range = 0.1 --how forgiving the accuracy is
    local ref_colorName = {
        ['Black'] = { r = 0.247, g = 0.247, b = 0.247 },
        ['Pink'] = { r = 0.96, g = 0.439, b = 0.807 },
        ['White'] = { r = 1, g = 1, b = 1 },
        ['Brown'] = { r = 0.153, g = 0.153, b = 0.153 },
        ['Red'] = { r = 0.856, g = 0.1, b = 0.094 },
        ['Orange'] = { r = 0.856, g = 0.392, b = 0.113 },
        ['Yellow'] = { r = 0.905, g = 0.898, b = 0.172 },
        ['Green'] = { r = 0.192, g = 0.702, b = 0.169 },
        ['Teal'] = { r = 0.129, g = 0.694, b = 0.607 },
        ['Blue'] = { r = 0.118, g = 0.53, b = 1 },
        ['Purple'] = { r = 0.627, g = 0.125, b = 0.941 }
    }
    for colorName, color in pairs(ref_colorName) do
        local r, g, b = false, false, false
        if math.abs(color.r - tint.r) <= range then
            r = true
        end
        if math.abs(color.g - tint.g) <= range then
            g = true
        end
        if math.abs(color.b - tint.b) <= range then
            b = true
        end
        if r and g and b then
            return colorName
        end
    end
    print('Color name not found.')
    return nil
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateButtonAroundCenter(pos, angle)
    local angle = math.rad(angle)
    local x = (pos.x or pos[1]) * math.cos(angle) + (pos.z or pos[3]) * math.sin(angle)
    local y = (pos.y or pos[2])
    --
    local z = (pos.x or pos[1]) * math.sin(angle) + (pos.z or pos[3]) * math.cos(angle)
    return { x = x, y = y, z = z, x, y, z }
end

--Orders the ship list (for use with ipairs, for consistancy)
function getShipList_ordered(shipList)
    shipList_ordered = {}
    for _, colorName in ipairs(ref_colorOrder) do
        if shipList[colorName] ~= nil then
            table.insert(shipList_ordered, { color = colorName, count = shipList[colorName] })
        end
    end
    return shipList_ordered
end

--Creates button or buttons on display
function createDisplayButtons(display, shipList)
    --Put ships into ordered list
    local shipList_ordered = getShipList_ordered(shipList)
    local shipCount = #shipList_ordered

    --Create buttons based on number of ships
    if shipCount == 0 then
        return
    elseif shipCount == 1 then
        display.createButton(
            {
                label = shipList_ordered[1].count,
                click_function = 'none',
                position = Vector(0, 0.29, 0),
                height = 0,
                width = 0,
                font_size = 800,
                font_color = stringColorToRGB(shipList_ordered[1].color)
            }
        )
    else
        --2
        local goalPos, font_size = Vector(0.4, 0.29, 0), 500
        --3-4
        if shipCount >= 3 then
            goalPos, font_size = Vector(0, 0.29, -0.45), 400
        end
        --5-8
        if shipCount >= 5 then
            goalPos, font_size = Vector(0, 0.29, -0.55), 300
        end

        local angleStep = 360 / shipCount
        for i, data in ipairs(shipList_ordered) do
            local pos = rotateButtonAroundCenter(goalPos, angleStep * i)
            display.createButton(
                {
                    label = data.count,
                    click_function = 'none',
                    position = pos,
                    height = 0,
                    width = 0,
                    font_size = font_size,
                    font_color = stringColorToRGB(data.color)
                }
            )
        end
    end
end

--Edit button or buttons on display
function updateDisplayButtons(display, shipList)
    --Put ships into ordered list
    local shipList_ordered = getShipList_ordered(shipList)
    for i, data in ipairs(shipList_ordered) do
        display.editButton({ index = i - 1, label = data.count })
    end
end

function hideUIElemForPlayer(color, id)
    local visibility = UI.getAttribute(id, 'visibility')
    local count = 0
    visibility, count = string.gsub(visibility, '%|' .. color .. '%|', '|')
    if count == 0 then
        visibility, count = string.gsub(visibility, '%|?' .. color .. '%|?', '')
    end
    if count > 0 then
        UI.setAttribute(id, 'visibility', visibility)
    end
end

function toggleUIElemForPlayer(color, id)
    local visibility = UI.getAttribute(id, 'visibility')
    if not string.find(visibility, color) then
        if visibility == '' then
            visibility = color
        else
            visibility = visibility .. '|' .. color
        end
        UI.setAttribute(id, 'visibility', visibility)
    else
        local count = 0
        visibility, count = string.gsub(visibility, '%|' .. color .. '%|', '|')
        if count == 0 then
            visibility, count = string.gsub(visibility, '%|?' .. color .. '%|?', '')
        end
        if count > 0 then
            UI.setAttribute(id, 'visibility', visibility)
        end
    end
end

    local visibility = UI.getAttribute(id, 'visibility')
    if not string.find(visibility, color) then
        if visibility == '' then
            visibility = color
        else
            visibility = visibility .. '|' .. color
        end
        UI.setAttribute(id, 'visibility', visibility)
    else

    end

ObjectStates.Description:
Secret Alliance Variant

Everyone that has selected an alliance from their tool will print out the results in the chat simultaneously.
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
--Sealed Bidding Tool
--master item
--created by Eskander
--optimized by Sirz Benjie


-----------------
--Imports
-----------------
local Color = Color
-----------------
--Vars
-----------------
bidCount = 0
masterGUID = '8d9974'

--master vars
slaveTools = {}
currentBids = {}
openBid = false
allConfirm = false
bidCountdown = false
countdownNum = 3

countdown3sParams = {
    identifier = '3sec',
    function_name = 'finalizeBid',
    delay = 4,
    repetitions = 1
}

countdown1sParams = {
    identifier = '1sec',
    function_name = 'countdown',
    delay = 1,
    repetitions = 3
}

-----------------
--Init
-----------------
function onLoad()
    --self report to master
    local guid = self.getGUID()
    local reportParams = {guid}
    master = getObjectFromGUID(masterGUID)
    master.call('reportIn', reportParams)

    --create buttons
    buttonsParams = {
        counterParams = {fcn = 'dud', l = '', dx = 0, dy = 0.00, w = 0, h = 0, f = 275},
        plusParams = {fcn = 'plusBid', l = '', dx = 1.75, dy = 0.95, w = 0, h = 0, f = 300},
        minusParams = {fcn = 'minusBid', l = '', dx = -1.75, dy = 0.95, w = 0, h = 0, f = 300},
        buttonParams = {fcn = 'enterBidding', l = 'Alliance', dx = 0, dy = 0.95, w = 1300, h = 300, f = 200}
    }
    local params = {}
    for k, v in pairs(buttonsParams) do
        params = buttonsParams[k]
        self.createButton(
            {
                click_function = params.fcn,
                function_owner = self,
                label = params.l,
                position = Vector(params.dx, 0.2, params.dy),
                width = params.w,
                height = params.h,
                font_size = params.f
            }
        )
    end
end

function initButtonIndex()
    --set indices
    local btns = {}
    btns = self.getButtons()
    for k, v in pairs(btns) do
        if v.click_function == 'dud' then
            bidDisplayI = v.index
        elseif v.click_function == 'plusBid' then
            bidPlusI = v.index
        elseif v.click_function == 'minusBid' then
            bidMinusI = v.index
        elseif v.click_function == 'enterBidding' then
            enterButtonI = v.index
        end
    end
end

----------------
--Master Fcns
----------------
--build list of slaves
function reportIn(params)
    local reportGUID = params[1]
    table.insert(slaveTools, getObjectFromGUID(reportGUID))
end

--start bidding round
function openBidding(params)
    local startGUID = params[1]
    local playerName = params[2]
    if openBid == false then
        openBid = true
        broadcastToAll(playerName .. ' has started an alliance phase. Commit Ships?', Color(0, 1, 0))
        currentBids = {}
    end
    currentBids[startGUID] = {p = playerName, contributes = 0, submitted = false}
end

--receive bid
function receiveBid(params)
    local guid = params[1]
    local bidNum = params[2]
    currentBids[guid].bid = bidNum
    currentBids[guid].submitted = true
    checkBids()
end

--retract bid
function retractBid(params)
    local guid = params[1]
    currentBids[guid].bid = 0
    currentBids[guid].submitted = false
end

--check bids
function checkBids()
    local notReady = false
    for k, v in pairs(currentBids) do
        if v.submitted == false then
            notReady = true
        end
    end
    if notReady == false then
        allConfirm = true
        if bidCountdown == false then
            bidCountdown = true
            lastCall()
        end
    elseif notReady == true then
        allConfirm = false
    end
end

--last call for bids
function lastCall()
    local num = 0
    for k, v in pairs(currentBids) do
        num = num + 1
    end
    broadcastToAll(
        'All ' .. num .. ' players have submitted their alliances. Last call to finalize your choice!',
        Color(1, 1, 0)
    )
    countdownNum = 3
    Timer.create(countdown1sParams)
    Timer.create(countdown3sParams)
    startLuaCoroutine(self, 'checkForCancel')
end

--check for cancel during countdown
function checkForCancel()
    while allConfirm == true do
        checkBids()
        coroutine.yield(0)
        if allConfirm == false and openBid == true then
            halt()
        end
    end
    return 1
end

--halt countdown
function halt()
    Timer.destroy('3sec')
    Timer.destroy('1sec')
    broadcastToAll('Last Call cancelled. Resume finalizing alliances.', Color(0, 1, 0))
    bidCountdown = false
end

--countdown
function countdown()
    printToAll('Ships finalized in ' .. countdownNum .. ' seconds.', Color(0, 1, 0))
    countdownNum = countdownNum - 1
end

--finalize bid
function finalizeBid()
    off = 0
    def = 0
    Timer.destroy('1sec')
    Timer.destroy('3sec')
    printToAll('Alliances commited!', Color(0, 1, 0))
    local reportTable = {}
    local i = 30
    local data = {}
    while i > -30 do
        for k, v in pairs(currentBids) do
            if v.bid == i then
                if v.bid < -5 then
                    v.bid = 'defensive foreign aid'
                elseif v.bid > 5 then
                    v.bid = 'offensive foreign aid'
                elseif v.bid == 5 then
                    v.bid = 'special offensive ships'
                elseif v.bid == -5 then
                    v.bid = 'special defensive ships'
                elseif v.bid == 0 then
                    v.bid = 'no one'
                elseif v.bid == 1 then
                    v.bid = '1 offensive ship'
                    off = off + 1
                elseif v.bid == 2 then
                    v.bid = '2 offensive ships'
                    off = off + 2
                elseif v.bid == 3 then
                    v.bid = '3 offensive ships'
                    off = off + 3
                elseif v.bid == 4 then
                    v.bid = '4 offensive ships'
                    off = off + 4
                elseif v.bid == -1 then
                    v.bid = '1 defensive ship'
                    def = def + 1
                elseif v.bid == -2 then
                    v.bid = '2 defensive ships'
                    def = def + 2
                elseif v.bid == -3 then
                    v.bid = '3 defensive ships'
                    def = def + 3
                elseif v.bid == -4 then
                    v.bid = '4 defensive ship'
                    def = def + 4
                end
                data = {v.p, v.bid}
                table.insert(reportTable, data)
            end
        end
        i = i - 1
    end
    for k, v in pairs(reportTable) do
        printToAll(v[1] .. ' allied with ' .. v[2] .. '.', Color(1, 1, 1))
    end
    broadcastToAll('Total Offensive allied ships: ' .. off .. '\nTotal Defensive allied ships: ' .. def, Color(0, 1, 1))
    openBid = false
    allConfirm = false
    bidCountdown = false
    local obj = {}
    for k, v in pairs(slaveTools) do
        obj = v
        obj.call('resetBidding')
    end
end
----------------
--Button Fcns
----------------
function enterBidding(object, playerColor)
    initButtonIndex()
    --edit buttons
    local params = {}
    local edits = {
        bidDisplay = {index = bidDisplayI, label = 'No Alliances'},
        bidPlus = {index = bidPlusI, label = '>', width = 300, height = 300},
        bidMinus = {index = bidMinusI, label = '<', width = 300, height = 300},
        bidSubmit = {index = enterButtonI, click_function = 'submitBid', label = 'Commit'}
    }
    for k, v in pairs(edits) do
        params = v
        self.editButton(params)
    end

    local playerName = Player[playerColor].steam_name
    printToAll(playerName .. ' is considering their alliances...', Color(1, 1, 0))

    local guid = object.getGUID()
    local openParams = {guid, playerName}
    openBidding(openParams)
end

function plusBid()
    bidCount = bidCount + 1
    updateBid()
end

function minusBid()
    bidCount = bidCount - 1

    updateBid()
end

function submitBid(object, playerColor)
    --edit buttons
    local params = {}
    local edits = {
        bidPlus = {index = bidPlusI, label = '', width = 0, height = 0},
        bidMinus = {index = bidMinusI, label = '', width = 0, height = 0},
        bidCancel = {index = enterButtonI, click_function = 'cancelBid', label = 'Cancel'}
    }
    for k, v in pairs(edits) do
        params = v
        self.editButton(params)
    end

    local playerName = Player[playerColor].steam_name
    printToAll(playerName .. ' has commited their ships', Color(1, 1, 0))

    local guid = object.getGUID()
    local submitParams = {guid, bidCount}
    receiveBid(submitParams)
end

function cancelBid(object, playerColor)
    --edit buttons
    local params = {}
    local edits = {
        bidPlus = {index = bidPlusI, label = '>', width = 300, height = 300},
        bidMinus = {index = bidMinusI, label = '<', width = 300, height = 300},
        bidCancel = {index = enterButtonI, click_function = 'submitBid', label = 'Commit'}
    }
    for k, v in pairs(edits) do
        params = v
        self.editButton(params)
    end

    local playerName = Player[playerColor].steam_name
    printToAll(playerName .. ' is reconsidering alliances.', Color(1, 1, 0))

    local guid = object.getGUID()
    local cancelParams = {guid}
    retractBid(cancelParams)
end

function dud()
end

---------------
--Utility Fcns
---------------

function updateBid()
    if bidCount == 0 then
        self.editButton({index = bidDisplayI, label = 'No Alliances'})
    elseif bidCount == 1 then
        self.editButton({index = bidDisplayI, label = '(1 Ship) Offense'})
    elseif bidCount == 2 then
        self.editButton({index = bidDisplayI, label = '(2 Ships) Offense'})
    elseif bidCount == 3 then
        self.editButton({index = bidDisplayI, label = '(3 Ships) Offense'})
    elseif bidCount == 4 then
        self.editButton({index = bidDisplayI, label = '(4 Ships) Offense'})
    elseif bidCount == 5 then
        self.editButton({index = bidDisplayI, label = '(Special) Offense'})
    elseif bidCount > 5 then
        self.editButton({index = bidDisplayI, label = '(Aid) Offense'})
    elseif bidCount == -1 then
        self.editButton({index = bidDisplayI, label = 'Defense (1 Ship)'})
    elseif bidCount == -2 then
        self.editButton({index = bidDisplayI, label = 'Defense (2 Ships)'})
    elseif bidCount == -3 then
        self.editButton({index = bidDisplayI, label = 'Defense (3 Ships)'})
    elseif bidCount == -4 then
        self.editButton({index = bidDisplayI, label = 'Defense (4 Ships)'})
    elseif bidCount == -5 then
        self.editButton({index = bidDisplayI, label = 'Defense (Special)'})
    elseif bidCount < -5 then
        self.editButton({index = bidDisplayI, label = 'Defense (Aid)'})
    else
        self.editButton({index = bidDisplayI, label = tostring(bidCount)})
    end
end

function resetBidding()
    bidCount = 0
    --edit buttons
    local params = {}
    local edits = {
        bidDisplay = {index = bidDisplayI, label = ''},
        bidPlus = {index = bidPlusI, label = '', width = 0, height = 0},
        bidMinus = {index = bidMinusI, label = '', width = 0, height = 0},
        bidCancel = {index = enterButtonI, click_function = 'enterBidding', label = 'Alliance'}
    }
    for k, v in pairs(edits) do
        params = v
        self.editButton(params)
    end
end

function returnTrimmedCardName(cardObject)
    return cardObject.getName():gsub("%s%(revised%)", ""):gsub("%s%(AT%)", ""):gsub("%sClassic%s", "")
end

function sortLogic(card_1, card_2)
    return (canonical_order_dict[returnTrimmedCardName(card_1)] or 999) <
        (canonical_order_dict[returnTrimmedCardName(card_2)] or 999)
end

function sortHand(_, player_color)
    -- If colorOverride is set, only allow the owner (or the Black player) to sort
    if colorOverride ~= nil and player_color ~= 'Black' and player_color ~= colorOverride then
        broadcastToColor("You cannot sort another player's hand!", player_color, "Red")
        return
    end
    local positionsList = {}

    local rawHandObjects = Player[colorOverride or player_color].getHandObjects()

    for _, handObject in pairs(rawHandObjects) do
        table.insert(positionsList, handObject.getPosition())
    end

    table.sort(rawHandObjects, sortLogic)

    for index, handObject in ipairs(rawHandObjects) do
        handObject.setPosition(positionsList[index])
        -- Ensure cards are face up after sorting
        handObject.setRotation(handObject.getRotation():setAt("z", 0))
    end
end

--[[Runs on code startup. If an override color is used, it will establish the tool for them. ]]
function onload()
    if colorOverride ~= '' then
        startTool(colorOverride)
        owner = colorOverride
    else
        --If there is no override color, it defaults to being unowned and is colored white
        self.setColorTint(stringColorToRGB('Grey'))
    end
end

--[[Toggles when the item is picked up if an override color isn't used. ]]
function onPickedUp(color)
    if colorOverride == '' then
        startTool(color)
    end
end

--[[Spawns the buttons, colors the tool for the owner, and remembers their color as "owner"]]
function startTool(color)
    self.setColorTint(stringColorToRGB(color))
    self.createButton(
        {
            label = "Sort",
            click_function = 'sortHand',
            function_owner = self,
            tooltip = "Sort your hand",
            position = Vector(0, 0.105, -0.65),
            width = 1500,
            height = 280,
            font_size = 200
        }
    )
    self.createButton(
        {
            label = 'Flip',
            click_function = 'flip',
            function_owner = self,
            tooltip = 'Flip player cards',
            position = Vector(-0.81, 0.105, 0.3),
            width = 725,
            height = 600,
            font_size = 200
        }
    )
    self.createButton(
        {

end

function sortLogic(card_1, card_2)

        (canonical_order_dict[returnTrimmedCardName(card_2)] or 999)
end

function sortHand(_, player_color)
    -- If colorOverride is set, only allow the owner (or the Black player) to sort
    if colorOverride ~= nil and player_color ~= 'Black' and player_color ~= colorOverride then
        broadcastToColor("You cannot sort another player's hand!", player_color, "Red")
        return
    end
    local positionsList = {}

    local rawHandObjects = Player[colorOverride or player_color].getHandObjects()

    for _, handObject in pairs(rawHandObjects) do
        table.insert(positionsList, handObject.getPosition())
    end

    table.sort(rawHandObjects, sortLogic)

    for index, handObject in ipairs(rawHandObjects) do
        handObject.setPosition(positionsList[index])
        -- Ensure cards are face up after sorting
        handObject.setRotation(handObject.getRotation():setAt("z", 0))
    end
end

--[[Runs on code startup. If an override color is used, it will establish the tool for them. ]]
function onload()
    if colorOverride ~= '' then
        startTool(colorOverride)
        owner = colorOverride
    else
        --If there is no override color, it defaults to being unowned and is colored white
        self.setColorTint(stringColorToRGB('Grey'))
    end
end

--[[Toggles when the item is picked up if an override color isn't used. ]]
function onPickedUp(color)
    if colorOverride == '' then
        startTool(color)
    end
end

--[[Spawns the buttons, colors the tool for the owner, and remembers their color as "owner"]]
function startTool(color)
    self.setColorTint(stringColorToRGB(color))
    self.createButton(
        {
            label = "Sort",
            click_function = 'sortHand',
            function_owner = self,
            tooltip = "Sort your hand",
            position = Vector(0, 0.105, -0.65),
            width = 1500,
            height = 280,
            font_size = 200
        }
    )
    self.createButton(
        {
            label = 'Flip',
            click_function = 'flip',
            function_owner = self,
            tooltip = 'Flip player cards',
            position = Vector(-0.81, 0.105, 0.3),
            width = 725,
            height = 600,
            font_size = 200
        }
    )
    self.createButton(
        {
            label = 'Shuffle',
            click_function = 'shuffleHand',
            function_owner = self,
            tooltip = 'Shuffle player cards and force facedown',
            position = Vector(0.81, 0.105, 0.3),
            width = 725,
            height = 600,
            font_size = 200
        }
    )
    self.createButton(
        {
            label = 'Group',
            click_function = 'groupHand',
            function_owner = self,
            tooltip = 'Group player cards\nUseful for moving or searching hands',
            position = Vector(0, 0.105, 1.25),
            width = 1500,
            height = 280,
            font_size = 200
        }
    )
    owner = color
end

--[[Flips all cards in the hand]]
function flip()
    --Gets cards from owner's hand
    local handObjects = Player[owner].getHandObjects()
    --Flips cards in owner's hand.
    for i, v in pairs(handObjects) do
        if v.type == 'Card' then
            v.flip()
        end
    end
end

--[[Shuffles all cards in the hand]]
function shuffleHand()
    --Gets cards from owner's hand
    local handObjects = Player[owner].getHandObjects()
    --Establishes the position of each card
    local cardPositions = {}
    for i, v in pairs(handObjects) do
        cardPositions[i] = v.getPosition()
    end
    --Activates shuffle of the table of cards
    local handObjectsShuffled = shuffleTable(handObjects)
    --Activates shuffle of the table of card positions
    local cardPositionsShuffled = shuffleTable(cardPositions)
    --Puts the shuffled cards into the shuffled card positions
    for i, v in pairs(handObjectsShuffled) do
        v.setRotation(v.getRotation():setAt('z', 180))
        v.setPosition(cardPositionsShuffled[i])
    end
end

--[[Shuffle function, is used twice to shuffle cards in the shuffleHand function ]]
function shuffleTable(t)
    for i = #t, 2, -1 do
        local n = math.random(i)
        t[i], t[n] = t[n], t[i]
    end
    return t
end

--[[Groups all cards into pile]]
function groupHand()
    --Gets cards from owner's hand
    local handObjects = Player[owner].getHandObjects()
    --Establishes the position of each card
    local cardPositions = {}
    for i, v in pairs(handObjects) do
        cardPositions[i] = v.getPosition()
    end
    --Activates shuffle of the table of cards
    local handObjectsShuffled = shuffleTable(handObjects)
    --Activates shuffle of the table of card positions
    local cardPositionsShuffled = shuffleTable(cardPositions)
    --shuffle cards and moves them to the coordinates
    for i, v in pairs(handObjectsShuffled) do
        if v.type == 'Card' then
            v.setPosition(cardPositionsShuffled[i])
            v.setRotation(self.getRotation():setAt('z', 180.0))
            v.setPosition(self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.25, 0))
        end
    end
end

function returnTrimmedCardName(cardObject)
    return cardObject.getName():gsub("%s%(revised%)", ""):gsub("%s%(AT%)", ""):gsub("%sClassic%s", "")
end

function sortLogic(card_1, card_2)
    return (canonical_order_dict[returnTrimmedCardName(card_1)] or 999) <
        (canonical_order_dict[returnTrimmedCardName(card_2)] or 999)
end

function sortHand(_, player_color)
    -- If colorOverride is set, only allow the owner (or the Black player) to sort
    if colorOverride ~= nil and player_color ~= 'Black' and player_color ~= colorOverride then
        broadcastToColor("You cannot sort another player's hand!", player_color, "Red")
        return
    end
    local positionsList = {}

    local rawHandObjects = Player[colorOverride or player_color].getHandObjects()

    for _, handObject in pairs(rawHandObjects) do
        table.insert(positionsList, handObject.getPosition())
    end

    table.sort(rawHandObjects, sortLogic)

    for index, handObject in ipairs(rawHandObjects) do
        handObject.setPosition(positionsList[index])
        -- Ensure cards are face up after sorting
        handObject.setRotation(handObject.getRotation():setAt("z", 0))
    end
end

--[[Runs on code startup. If an override color is used, it will establish the tool for them. ]]
function onload()
    if colorOverride ~= '' then
        startTool(colorOverride)
        owner = colorOverride
    else
        --If there is no override color, it defaults to being unowned and is colored white
        self.setColorTint(stringColorToRGB('Grey'))
    end
end

--[[Toggles when the item is picked up if an override color isn't used. ]]
function onPickedUp(color)
    if colorOverride == '' then
        startTool(color)
    end
end

--[[Spawns the buttons, colors the tool for the owner, and remembers their color as "owner"]]
function startTool(color)
    self.setColorTint(stringColorToRGB(color))
    self.createButton(
        {
            label = "Sort",
            click_function = 'sortHand',
            function_owner = self,
            tooltip = "Sort your hand",
            position = Vector(0, 0.105, -0.65),
            width = 1500,
            height = 280,
            font_size = 200
        }
    )
    self.createButton(
        {
            label = 'Flip',
            click_function = 'flip',
            function_owner = self,
            tooltip = 'Flip player cards',
            position = Vector(-0.81, 0.105, 0.3),
            width = 725,
            height = 600,
            font_size = 200
        }
    )
    self.createButton(
        {
            label = 'Shuffle',
            click_function = 'shuffleHand',
            function_owner = self,
            tooltip = 'Shuffle player cards and force facedown',
            position = Vector(0.81, 0.105, 0.3),
            width = 725,
            height = 600,
            font_size = 200
        }
    )
    self.createButton(
        {
            label = 'Group',
            click_function = 'groupHand',
            function_owner = self,
            tooltip = 'Group player cards\nUseful for moving or searching hands',
            position = Vector(0, 0.105, 1.25),
            width = 1500,
            height = 280,
            font_size = 200
        }
    )
    owner = color
end

--[[Flips all cards in the hand]]
function flip()
    --Gets cards from owner's hand
    local handObjects = Player[owner].getHandObjects()
    --Flips cards in owner's hand.
    for i, v in pairs(handObjects) do
        if v.type == 'Card' then
            v.flip()
        end
    end
end

--[[Shuffles all cards in the hand]]
function shuffleHand()
    --Gets cards from owner's hand
    local handObjects = Player[owner].getHandObjects()
    --Establishes the position of each card
    local cardPositions = {}
    for i, v in pairs(handObjects) do
        cardPositions[i] = v.getPosition()
    end
    --Activates shuffle of the table of cards
    local handObjectsShuffled = shuffleTable(handObjects)
    --Activates shuffle of the table of card positions
    local cardPositionsShuffled = shuffleTable(cardPositions)
    --Puts the shuffled cards into the shuffled card positions
    for i, v in pairs(handObjectsShuffled) do
        v.setRotation(v.getRotation():setAt('z', 180))
        v.setPosition(cardPositionsShuffled[i])
    end
end

--[[Shuffle function, is used twice to shuffle cards in the shuffleHand function ]]
function shuffleTable(t)
    for i = #t, 2, -1 do
        local n = math.random(i)
        t[i], t[n] = t[n], t[i]
    end
    return t
end

--[[Groups all cards into pile]]
function groupHand()
    --Gets cards from owner's hand
    local handObjects = Player[owner].getHandObjects()
    --Establishes the position of each card
    local cardPositions = {}
    for i, v in pairs(handObjects) do
        cardPositions[i] = v.getPosition()
    end
    --Activates shuffle of the table of cards
    local handObjectsShuffled = shuffleTable(handObjects)
    --Activates shuffle of the table of card positions
    local cardPositionsShuffled = shuffleTable(cardPositions)
    --shuffle cards and moves them to the coordinates
    for i, v in pairs(handObjectsShuffled) do
        if v.type == 'Card' then
            v.setPosition(cardPositionsShuffled[i])
            v.setRotation(self.getRotation():setAt('z', 180.0))
            v.setPosition(self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.25, 0))
        end
    end
end

    return JSON.encode({color = watchedColor})
end
function onLoad(save_state)
    --vvv reload the color of the player to count the cards of. vvv
    local saved_data = JSON.decode(save_state)
    watchedColor = saved_data.color

    --vvv error check. If matching hand zone doesn't exist, print that error message with fix in chat

        click_function = "null", function_owner = self,
        label = "0", tooltip = objectCount.." cards in your hand",
        position = Vector(0, 0.2, 0), scale = buttonScale,
        width = 900, height = 800, font_size = 1100

    self.addContextMenuItem("INCREASE size", increaseScale, true)
    self.addContextMenuItem("[cccccc]decrease[-] size", decreaseScale, true)

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
local Vector = Vector
    local Color = Color
    --    MrStump's Scripted Countdown Timer

--Variables that can be edited to change timer behavior

--The default starting time for the timer in seconds.
--This is what the time is if your timeMod = 0 (before you hit + or -)
defaultStartTime = 30
--This is how much + or - buttons effect timeMod.
--In other words, how much the time increases/decreses by
amountToModBy = 15
--The following are colors for the timer to change to, in {R,G,B} format
--RGB values should be between 0 and 1
--Reset and idle color
colorReset = Color(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
--Paused color
colorPause = Color(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
--Running color
colorRun = Color(0.2, 1, 0.2)
--Time has run out color
colorEnd = Color(1, 0.2, 0.2)

--Setup that runs when tool is loaded/saved

--Runs whenever this object is saved, individually or as part of atable
function onSave()
    local data_to_save = {tc = timeCount, tm = timeMod}
    local saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    return saved_data
end

--Runs only when the timer is first loaded on the table
function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= nil and saved_data ~= '' then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        timeCount = loaded_data.tc
        timeMod = loaded_data.tm
    else
        timeCount = 0
        timeMod = 0
    end
    if timeCount > 0 then
        self.setColorTint(colorPause)
    end
    if defaultStartTime - timeCount + timeMod <= 0 then
        self.setColorTint(colorEnd)
    end
    runTimer = false
    disablePauseOrStart = false
    createButtons()
end

--Running processes to do the actuall counting, and knowing when to stop

--When runTimer is true, this does the counting to track time passing
function update()
    if runTimer == true then
        calculateDelta()
        timeCount = timeCount + 1 * deltaTime
        updateDisplays()
        if timeCount >= defaultStartTime + timeMod then
            broadcastToAll(string.char(8987) .. " - Time's Up - " .. string.char(8987), Color(1, 1, 1))
            self.setColorTint(colorEnd)
            runTimer = false
            disablePauseOrStart = true
        end
    end
end

--Determines the real time between the last update and this one to keep count accurate
function calculateDelta()
    local oldTime = newTime
    newTime = os.clock()
    deltaTime = newTime - oldTime
end

--Display/naming/color, to format the cube and buttons visually

--Updates the time to the 4 side displays
function updateDisplays()
    local timeForDisplay = getTimeString()
    --This if statement cuts way down on the amount of button updates being done
    if self.getButtons()[1].label ~= timeForDisplay then
        for i = 0, 3 do
            self.editButton({index = i, label = timeForDisplay})
        end
    end
end

--Converts a number in seconds only into minutes/seconds and returns it
function getTimeString()
    local timeInSeconds = math.ceil(defaultStartTime + timeMod - timeCount)
    local minutes = math.floor(timeInSeconds / 60)
    local seconds = timeInSeconds % 60
    return string.format('%d:%02d', minutes, seconds)
end

--Click Functions (what happens when you click buttons)

--Runs when a side is clicked, starts/stops timer
function pauseOrStart()
    if disablePauseOrStart == false then
        if runTimer == false then
            newTime = os.clock()
            runTimer = true
            self.setColorTint(colorRun)
        else
            runTimer = false
            self.setColorTint(colorPause)
        end
    end
end

--Activated by the reset button, resetting and stopping it if needed
function resetTimer()
    timeCount = 0
    runTimer = false
    disablePauseOrStart = false
    updateDisplays()
    self.setColorTint(colorReset)
end

--The + button, adds time to timeMod to increase total timer time
function moreTime()
    if runTimer == false then
        timeMod = timeMod + amountToModBy
        updateDisplays()
    end
end

    if Global.getVar('current_phase') == 1 and alt then return end
    getObjectFromGUID('a10b0d').call('phase_used')

    local color = colorBroadcast[Turns.turn_color] or Color(1, 1, 1)

    if alt then
        if count > 0 then
            count = count - 2
        end
    end

    --checks extreme hazards variant
    if not extremetoken.is_face_down and changetoken.is_face_down then
        extreme = 1
    end

    if count == 0 then
        Global.call('setPhase', 1)
        broadcastToAll('Start Turn Phase', color)
    elseif count == 1 then
        --if change == 1 or extreme == 1 then
        --getObjectFromGUID('a10b0d').call('hazardactive')
        --end
        Global.call('setPhase', 2)
        broadcastToAll('Regroup Phase', color)
    elseif count == 2 then
        Global.call('setPhase', 3)
        broadcastToAll('Destiny Phase', color)
        if change == 1 or extreme == 1 then
            getObjectFromGUID('a10b0d').call('hazardactive')
        end
    elseif count == 3 then
        Global.call('setPhase', 4)
        broadcastToAll('Launch Phase', color)
        if change == 1 or extreme == 1 then
            getObjectFromGUID('a10b0d').call('hazardactive')
        end
    elseif count == 4 then

        broadcastToAll('Alliance Phase', color)
        if change == 1 or extreme == 1 then
            getObjectFromGUID('a10b0d').call('hazardactive')
        end
    elseif count == 5 then
        Global.call('setPhase', 6)
        broadcastToAll('Planning Phase', color)
        if change == 1 or extreme == 1 then
            getObjectFromGUID('a10b0d').call('hazardactive')
        end
    elseif count == 6 then
        Global.call('setPhase', 7)
        broadcastToAll('Reveal Phase', color)
        if change == 1 or extreme == 1 then
            getObjectFromGUID('a10b0d').call('hazardactive')
        end
    elseif count == 7 then
        Global.call('setPhase', 8)
        broadcastToAll('Resolution Phase', color)
        if change == 1 or extreme == 1 then
            getObjectFromGUID('a10b0d').call('hazardactive')
        end
    else
        Global.UI.setAttribute("PhaseIndicator", "image", "Empty Phase Bar")
        broadcastToAll('Additional Encounter?', color)
        getObjectFromGUID('a10b0d').call('hazarddeactive')
        self.call('Discard')

        --checks second encounter hazard warning variant
        if extremetoken.is_face_down and not changetoken.is_face_down then
            change = 1
        end

        count = 0
    end

    --if alt then
    --else
    count = count + 1
    --end

    log('Locating primary pile for ' .. color .. ' ' .. kind .. '.', '', 'Dealerb3ad93')

local function toggleExpansion(player, expansion, click)
    updateButtonIndices()
    local uppercase_expansion = (expansion:gsub('^%l', string.upper))
    if toggles[expansion] then
        -- select
        toggles[expansion] = false
        self.editButton(
            {
                index = expansionButtonIndex[expansion],
                tooltip = format('Add %s aliens', uppercase_expansion),
            }
        )
        self.UI.setAttribute(format('%sLogoBG', expansion), 'color', deselectedExpansionFill)
    else
        -- deselect
        toggles[expansion] = true
        self.editButton(
            {
                index = expansionButtonIndex[expansion],
                tooltip = format('Do not add %s aliens', uppercase_expansion),
            }
        )
        self.UI.setAttribute(format('%sLogoBG', expansion), 'color', selectedExpansionFill)
    end
end

--- Because of limitations with TTS's classic UI, we need a function for each.. Just call the one we actually want
function toggleBase(_, player, click)
    toggleExpansion(player, 'base', click)
end

function toggleIncursion(_, player, click)
    toggleExpansion(player, 'incursion', click)
end

function toggleConflict(_, player, click)
    toggleExpansion(player, 'conflict', click)
end

function toggleAlliance(_, player, click)
    toggleExpansion(player, 'alliance', click)
end

function toggleStorm(_, player, click)
    toggleExpansion(player, 'storm', click)
end

function toggleDominion(_, player, click)
    toggleExpansion(player, 'dominion', click)
end

    toggleExpansion(player, 'eons', click)
end

function toggleOdyssey(_, player, click)

end

--- Confirms all expansions.
function confirmAllExpansions(_, player, click)
    updateButtonIndices()
    for i, expansion in ipairs(ALL_EXPANSIONS) do
        toggles[expansion] = true
        if expansionButtonIndex[expansion] ~= nil then
            self.removeButton(expansionButtonIndex[expansion])
        end
        self.UI.setAttribute(string.format('%sLogoBG', expansion), 'active', false)
        updateButtonIndices()
    end
    self.removeButton(expansionButtonIndex['confirmAll'])
    updateButtonIndices()
    if expansionButtonIndex['confirmSelected'] ~= nil then
        self.removeButton(expansionButtonIndex['confirmSelected'])
        updateButtonIndices()
    end

    Wait.condition(
        takeExpansionComponents,
        function()
            return takingExpansionComponents == false
        end
    )
end

function confirmSelected()
    updateButtonIndices()
    local anyConfirmed = false
    for _, expansion in ipairs(ALL_EXPANSIONS) do
        if toggles[expansion] then
            if expansionButtonIndex[expansion] ~= nil then
                self.removeButton(expansionButtonIndex[expansion])
            end
            self.UI.setAttribute(string.format('%sLogoBG', expansion), 'active', false)
            updateButtonIndices()
        end
    end

    -- takeExpansionComponents()
    Wait.condition(
        takeExpansionComponents,
        function()
            return takingExpansionComponents == false
        end
    )
end

    self.clearButtons()

local function takeAndPut(box, params, target)
    local obj = box.takeObject(params)
    local yBounds = obj.getBoundsNormalized().size.y
    if target ~= nil and not target.isDestroyed() then
        target.putObject(obj)
    end
    return yBounds
end

local function takeFirst(box, params)
    local obj = box.takeObject(params)
    return obj
end

local function deepTableCopy(table)
    local new_table = {}
    for k, v in ipairs(table) do
        if type(v) == 'table' then
            new_table[k] = deepTableCopy[v]
        else
            new_table[k] = v
        end
    end

    for k, v in pairs(table) do
        if type(v) == 'table' then
            new_table[k] = deepTableCopy[v]
        else
            new_table[k] = v
        end
    end

    return new_table
end

local function takeParamsWithOffset(params, y_offset)
    params.position.y = y_offset
    return params
end

local function takeExpansionComponentsFirst()
    local box = nil
    for _, expansion in ipairs(ALL_EXPANSIONS) do
        if toggles[expansion] then
            firstcheck = true
            takingExpansionComponents = true
            confirmedExpansions[expansion] = true
            box = getObjectFromGUID(EXPANSION_BOX_GUIDS[expansion])
            if box == nil
            then
                error('Unable to locate the ' .. expansion .. ' box. Please select aliens manually.')
            end

            alienAndFlareRefs['Green Aliens'] = box.takeObject(GREEN_ALIEN_PARAMS)
            Global.call('setPrimaryAlienPile', alienAndFlareRefs['Green Aliens'].guid)
            alienAndFlareGUIDs[alienAndFlareRefs['Green Aliens'].guid] = 'Green Aliens'

            alienAndFlareRefs['Yellow Aliens'] = box.takeObject(YELLOW_ALIEN_PARAMS)
            alienAndFlareGUIDs[alienAndFlareRefs['Yellow Aliens'].guid] = 'Yellow Aliens'
            alienAndFlareRefs['Yellow Aliens'].setLuaScript('function tryRandomize() return false end')

            alienAndFlareRefs['Red Aliens'] = box.takeObject(RED_ALIEN_PARAMS)
            alienAndFlareGUIDs[alienAndFlareRefs['Red Aliens'].guid] = 'Red Aliens'
            alienAndFlareRefs['Red Aliens'].setLuaScript('function tryRandomize() return false end')

            alienAndFlareRefs['Green Flares'] = box.takeObject(GREEN_FLARE_PARAMS)
            alienAndFlareGUIDs[alienAndFlareRefs['Green Flares'].guid] = 'Green Flares'
            Global.call('setPrimaryFlarePile', alienAndFlareRefs['Green Flares'].guid)

            alienAndFlareRefs['Yellow Flares'] = box.takeObject(YELLOW_FLARE_PARAMS)
            alienAndFlareGUIDs[alienAndFlareRefs['Yellow Flares'].guid] = 'Yellow Flares'

            alienAndFlareRefs['Red Flares'] = box.takeObject(RED_FLARE_PARAMS)
            alienAndFlareGUIDs[alienAndFlareRefs['Red Flares'].guid] = 'Red Flares'

            function alienAndFlareRefsFinishedLoading()
                for _, obj in pairs(alienAndFlareRefs) do
                    while obj.loading_custom do
                        yield(0)
                    end

                    -- Uncomment to stop these decks from being randomized.
                    -- the issue is that we need to re-enable randomization
                    local itemPos = obj.getPosition()
                    obj.setPosition(Vector(itemPos.x, 8.15 + obj.getBoundsNormalized().size.y / 2, itemPos.z))
                end
                takeAT(box, expansion)
                takingExpansionComponents = false
                return 1
            end

            startLuaCoroutine(self, 'alienAndFlareRefsFinishedLoading')
            break
        end
    end
end

local function confirmExpansion(expansion)
    confirmedExpansions[expansion] = true
    updateButtonIndices()
    if expansionButtonIndex[expansion] ~= nil then
        self.removeButton(expansionButtonIndex[expansion])
    end
    self.UI.setAttribute(string.format('%sLogoBG', expansion), 'active', false)
    updateButtonIndices()
end

function takeExpansionComponents()
    if next(alienAndFlareRefs) == nil then
        takingExpansionComponents = true
        takeExpansionComponentsFirst()
    end

    for _, expansion in ipairs(ALL_EXPANSIONS) do
        if toggles[expansion] and not confirmedExpansions[expansion] then
            confirmExpansion(expansion)
            local box = getObjectFromGUID(EXPANSION_BOX_GUIDS[expansion])
            if box == nil or box.isDestroyed() then
                broadcastToAll(
                    string.format('Unable to locate the %s box. Please select aliens manually.', expansion),
                    'Red'
                )
            end
            Wait.condition(
                function()
                    local y_bounds = 0.25
                    y_bounds =
                        math.max(
                            y_bounds,
                            takeAndPut(
                                box,
                                takeParamsWithOffset(GREEN_ALIEN_PARAMS, y_offset),
                                alienAndFlareRefs['Green Aliens']
                            )
                        )
                    y_bounds =
                        math.max(
                            y_bounds,
                            takeAndPut(
                                box,
                                takeParamsWithOffset(YELLOW_ALIEN_PARAMS, y_offset),
                                alienAndFlareRefs['Yellow Aliens']
                            )
                        )
                    y_bounds =
                        math.max(
                            y_bounds,
                            takeAndPut(
                                box,
                                takeParamsWithOffset(RED_ALIEN_PARAMS, y_offset),
                                alienAndFlareRefs['Red Aliens']
                            )
                        )
                    y_bounds =
                        math.max(
                            y_bounds,
                            takeAndPut(
                                box,
                                takeParamsWithOffset(GREEN_FLARE_PARAMS, y_offset),
                                alienAndFlareRefs['Green Flares']
                            )
                        )
                    y_bounds =
                        math.max(
                            y_bounds,
                            takeAndPut(
                                box,
                                takeParamsWithOffset(YELLOW_FLARE_PARAMS, y_offset),
                                alienAndFlareRefs['Yellow Flares']
                            )
                        )
                    y_bounds =
                        math.max(
                            y_bounds,
                            takeAndPut(
                                box,
                                takeParamsWithOffset(RED_FLARE_PARAMS, y_offset),
                                alienAndFlareRefs['Red Flares']
                            )
                        )
                    y_bounds = math.max(y_bounds, takeAT(box, expansion))
                    y_offset = y_offset + y_bounds
                    takingExpansionComponents = false
                end,
                function()
                    return takingExpansionComponents == false
                end
            )
        end
    end
    return 1
end

local MOVE_TO_VOID_POSITION = Vector(-108.63, 12, -0.84)
local function move_to_void(obj)
    if obj == nil or obj.isDestroyed() then
        return
    else
        obj.setLock(false)
    end
    local void = getObjectFromGUID('cf6ca1')
    if void ~= nil then
        void.putObject(obj)
    else
        obj.setPositionSmooth(MOVE_TO_VOID_POSITION, false, true)
    end
end

function check_piles(green, red, yellow, flares)
    for ref, do_check in pairs(
        {
            ['Green Aliens'] = green,
            ['Yellow Aliens'] = yellow,
            ['Red Aliens'] = red,
            ['Green Flares'] = green and flares,
            ['Yellow Flares'] = yellow and flares,
            ['Red Flares'] = red and flares
        }
    ) do
        if do_check and (alienAndFlareRefs[ref] == nil or alienAndFlareRefs[ref].isDestroyed()) then
            log(format('Unable to locate %s', ref), '', 'Dealerb3ad93')
            return false
        end
    end
    log('Successfully located aliens and flares', '', 'Dealerb3ad93')
    return true
end

local function moveToCenter(obj, is_flare, smooth)
    if obj.isDestroyed() or obj == nil then
        log("Attempting to move destroyd object", '', 'Dealerb3ad93')
        return
    end
    if smooth == nil or type(smooth) ~= 'boolean' then
        smooth = false
    end
    local pos
    if is_flare then
        pos = center_flare_position
    else
        pos = center_alien_position
    end

    if obj ~= nil and not obj.isDestroyed() then
        if smooth then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(pos, false, true)
        else
            obj.setPosition(pos)
        end
    elseif obj == nil then
        log('Could not move to center as the object is nil', '', 'Dealerb3ad93')
    end
end


local function moveToPrimaryAliens(obj)
    local aliens = getPrimaryPile('Green', 'Aliens')
    if obj ~= nil and (not obj.isDestroyed()) and aliens ~= nil and not aliens.isDestroyed() then
        aliens.putObject(obj)
        return aliens
    else
        if obj == nil then log('Could not move to primary pile as it references a nil', '', 'Dealerb3ad93') end
        if aliens == nil then
            log('Could not move to primary alien pile as that pile is nil', '', 'Dealerb3ad93')
        elseif aliens.isDestroyed() then
            log('Could not move to primary pile as it references a destroyed object', '',
                'Dealerb3ad93')
        end
    end
end

local function moveToPrimaryFlares(obj)
    -- flares is first non nil
    local flares = getPrimaryPile('Green', 'Flares')
    if
        flares ~= nil and obj ~= nil and (not obj.isDestroyed()) and flares ~= nil and
        not flares.isDestroyed()
    then
        flares.putObject(obj)
        return flares
    else
        log('Could not locate primary flare pile', '', 'Dealerb3ad93')
    end
end
