--- Returns the pile closest to the specified color that is not nil.

local function dealToPlayer(color, dealParams, dealCount, color_counts, flares)
    if not (Player[color].seated or getObjectFromGUID(dealParams.guid) == nil) then return end
    local alienParams = { smooth = false }
    local flareParams = { smooth = false }
    -- minor performance optimization to avoid creating these tables 8 times

    if flares == 'deck' then
        flareParams.position = Vector(-8.33, 4, 2.06)
        flareParams.rotation = Vector(0.00, 210.0, 180.00)
    end

    local playerPlacer = getObjectFromGUID(dealParams.guid)
    if playerPlacer ~= nil then
        playerPlacer.call('Move')
    end
    if dealCount == 0 then
        return
    end
    alienParams.position = dealParams.position
    alienParams.rotation = dealParams.rotation
    for numToDeal = 1, dealCount do
        local random_index = 1
        if beginnerGreen[color] then
            random_index = math.random(color_counts['green'])
        else
            random_index = math.random(color_counts['green'] + color_counts['yellow'] + color_counts['red'])
        end

        local deck_color = ''
        local alien_pile_ref = nil
        local flare_pile_ref = nil
        -- If/else chain to determine which deck the random alien will be dealt from
        -- Assign the alien and flare piles
        -- Assign the
        if random_index <= color_counts['green'] then
            deck_color = 'green'
            alien_pile_ref = alienAndFlareRefs['Green Aliens']
            flare_pile_ref = alienAndFlareRefs['Green Flares']
            alienParams.index = random_index - 1
            flareParams.index = random_index - 1
            color_counts['green'] = color_counts['green'] - 1
            if color_counts['green'] == 0 then
                broadcastToAll('No more green aliens to deal', 'Red')
                alienAndFlareRefs['Green Aliens'] = nil
                alienAndFlareRefs['Green Flares'] = nil
            end
        elseif random_index <= color_counts['green'] + color_counts['yellow'] then
            deck_color = 'yellow'
            alien_pile_ref = alienAndFlareRefs['Yellow Aliens']
            flare_pile_ref = alienAndFlareRefs['Yellow Flares']
            alienParams.index = random_index - color_counts['green'] - 1
            flareParams.index = random_index - color_counts['green'] - 1
            color_counts['yellow'] = color_counts['yellow'] - 1
            if color_counts['yellow'] == 0 then
                broadcastToAll('No more yellow aliens to deal', 'Red')
                alienAndFlareRefs['Yellow Aliens'] = nil
                alienAndFlareRefs['Yellow Flares'] = nil
            end
        else
            deck_color = 'red'
            alien_pile_ref = alienAndFlareRefs['Red Aliens']
            flare_pile_ref = alienAndFlareRefs['Red Flares']
            alienParams.index = random_index - (color_counts['green'] + color_counts['yellow']) - 1
            flareParams.index = random_index - (color_counts['green'] + color_counts['yellow']) - 1
            color_counts['red'] = color_counts['red'] - 1
            if color_counts['red'] == 0 then
                broadcastToAll('No more red aliens to deal', 'Red')
                alienAndFlareRefs['Red Aliens'] = nil
                alienAndFlareRefs['Red Flares'] = nil
            end
        end
        log(
            format(
                'Randomly dealing card #%d to color %s from %s. Random index is: %d, Index is: %d',
                numToDeal,
                color,
                deck_color,
                random_index,
                alienParams.index
            ),
            '',
            'Dealerb3ad93'
        )

        if alien_pile_ref.getQuantity() == -1 then
            alien_pile_ref.deal(1, color)
        else
            alien_pile_ref.takeObject(alienParams).deal(1, color)
        end


        if flares ~= 'none' then
            flareParams.index = alienParams.index
            if flares == 'hands' then
                flareParams.position = dealParams.position
                flareParams.rotation = dealParams.rotation
                if flare_pile_ref.getQuantity() == -1 then
                    flare_pile_ref.deal(1, color)
                else
                    flare_pile_ref.takeObject(flareParams).deal(1, color)
                end
            else
                if flare_pile_ref.getQuantity() == -1 then
                    flare_pile_ref.setPosition(flareParams.position)
                    flare_pile_ref.setRotation(flareParams.rotation)
                else
                    flare_pile_ref.takeObject(flareParams)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function Deal(count, allow_yellow, allow_red, flares, no_broadcast)
    if count == 0 then
        return
    end
    if flares == nil or type(flares) ~= 'string' or (flares ~= 'none' and flares ~= 'hands' and flares ~= 'deck') then
        flares = 'deck'
    end
    if no_broadcast == nil then
        no_broadcast = false
    end
    if allow_yellow == nil then
        allow_yellow = false
    end
    if allow_red == nil then
        allow_yellow = false
    end

    log(
        format(
            'Dealing %d aliens, allowing yellow: %s, allowing red: %s, dealing flares to: %s',
            count,
            logString(allow_yellow),
            logString(allow_red),
            flares
        ),
        '',
        'Dealerb3ad93'
    )


    local green_count = alienAndFlareRefs['Green Aliens'].getQuantity()
    if green_count == -1 then
        green_count = 1
    end
    local yellow_count = 0
    local red_count = 0

    if allow_yellow then
        yellow_count = alienAndFlareRefs['Yellow Aliens'].getQuantity()
        -- calling getQuantity() on a card returns -1.
        if yellow_count == -1 then
            yellow_count = 1
        end
    end

    if allow_red then
        red_count = alienAndFlareRefs['Red Aliens'].getQuantity()
        if red_count == -1 then
            red_count = 1
        end
    end

    local pileCounts = { green = green_count, yellow = yellow_count, red = red_count }

    local seats = Global.call('count_seated_players')
    if seats < 3 and not no_broadcast then
        broadcastToAll(
            'Requires at least 3 players to play! (found ' ..
            seats .. '). Continue testing or please reload game and try again.',
            Color(1, 0, 1)
        )
    end
    for color, dealParams in pairs(Global.getTable('PlayerDealerParams')) do
        dealToPlayer(color, dealParams, count, pileCounts, flares)
    end

    if seats > 6 then
        local alliancedeck = getObjectFromGUID('3d4e8f')
        ---@
        if alliancedeck then
            alliancedeck.call('Move')
        end
    end

    if count == 0 then
        return
    end

    if flares == 'hands' then
        broadcastToAll(
            "Select your alien by placing it on your tile, then select 2 flares to mix into the Cosmic Deck (One of the flares must match your alien). Throw the aliens/flares you don't use off the table.",
            Color(0, 1, 1)
        )
    else
        broadcastToAll(
            'Select your alien by placing it on your tile. Throw the unused alien off the table. Follow any "Game Setup" aliens before starting!',
            Color(0, 1, 1)
        )
    end
end

function shuffleIfExists(obj)
    if obj ~= nil and not obj.isDestroyed() then
        obj.shuffle()
    end
end

function HB(params)
    -- if any existing aliens have been confirmed, then combine them into a single pile.
    lockDealing = true

    if not firstcheck then
        log('Dealing homebrew aliens only.', '', 'Dealerb3ad93')
        -- None of the expansions have been selected. Only deal from homebrew.
        alienAndFlareRefs['Green Aliens'] = params.aliens
        alienAndFlareRefs['Green Flares'] = params.flares
        alienAndFlareGUIDs[params.aliens.guid] = 'Green Aliens'
        alienAndFlareGUIDs[params.flares.guid] = 'Green Flares'
        Deal(Global.getVar('DealCount'), false, false, 'hands')
        wait_frames(
            function()
                moveToCenter(alienAndFlareRefs['Green Aliens'])
                moveToCenter(alienAndFlareRefs['Green Flares'], true)
                shuffleIfExists(alienAndFlareRefs['Green Aliens'])
                shuffleIfExists(alienAndFlareRefs['Green Flares'])
                clearUnusedExpansionButtons()
                lockDealing = false
                Global.setVar('dealingComplete', true)
            end,
            0.5
        )
    else
        log('Dealing mix of homebrew and official aliens.', '', 'Dealerb3ad93')
        local red_aliens = getPrimaryPile('Red', 'Aliens')
        local red_flares = getPrimaryPile('Red', 'Flares')
        red_aliens.putObject(params.aliens)
        red_flares.putObject(params.flares)
        Deal(Global.getVar('DealCount'), true, true, 'hands')
        time(
            function()
                local primary_aliens = moveToPrimaryAliens(alienAndFlareRefs['Yellow Aliens'])
                local primary_flares = moveToPrimaryFlares(alienAndFlareRefs['Yellow Flares'])
                wait_frames(
                    function()
                        primary_aliens = moveToPrimaryAliens(alienAndFlareRefs['Red Aliens'])
                        primary_flares = moveToPrimaryFlares(alienAndFlareRefs['Red Flares'])
                    end,
                    2
                )

                wait_frames(
                    function()
                        alienAndFlareRefs['Green Aliens'].shuffle()
                        alienAndFlareRefs['Green Flares'].shuffle()
                        moveToCenter(primary_aliens)
                        moveToCenter(primary_flares, true)
                        addRemainingFlares()
                        clearUnusedExpansionButtons()
                        lockDealing = false
                        Global.setVar('dealingComplete', true)
                    end,
                    4
                )
            end,
            0.5
        )
    end
end

function yesflare()
    sflare = true
end

function noflare()
    sflare = false
end

function yesmany()
    bdeck = true
end

function nomany()
    bdeck = false
end

function setGreen(color)
    beginnerGreen[color] = true
    if Player[color].seated then
        broadcastToColor('You will only be dealt green aliens.', color, Color(0, 1, 1))
    else
        broadcastToAll(color .. 'will only be dealt green aliens.', Color(0, 1, 1))
    end
end

function reset()
    --determine first player
    if getObjectFromGUID('3b50f5') then
        getObjectFromGUID('3b50f5').call('PrintRandomOrder')
    end

    self.destruct()
end

-- the last step for the dealer.  Removes the remaining flares.
function addRemainingFlares()
    -- Do not add flares if the option is turned off.
    if not sflare then
        return
    end
    local num_seated = Global.call('count_confirmed_players')

    local flares = getPrimaryPile('Green', 'Flares')
    if num_seated >= 5 or flares == nil or flares.isDestroyed() then
        self.clearButtons()
        return
    end
    local params = {
        position = Vector(-8.33, 4, 2.06),
        rotation = Vector(0.00, 210.0, 180.00),
        index = 0,
        smooth = false
    }
    local flares_needed = (5 - num_seated) * 2
    if flares.getQuantity() < flares_needed then
        broadcastToAll(
            'Could not find enough unused flares to bring the flare count up to 10. Please add the rest to the Cosmic Deck manually.',
            Color(0, 1, 1)
        )
    end

    log('Adding ' .. flares_needed .. ' flares to the Cosmic Deck.', '', 'Dealerb3ad93')

    for i = 1, flares_needed do
        flares.takeObject(params)
    end
    print('Random flares are selected and mixed into the Cosmic Deck for small game.')
end

function cycleAT()
    ATstate = (ATstate + 1) % 3
    if ATstate == 2 then
        broadcastToAll('Both alternate timeline and classic aliens will be used', Color(0, 1, 1))
    elseif ATstate == 1 then
        broadcastToAll('Classic aliens will be used', Color(0, 1, 1))
    else
        broadcastToAll('Alternate timeline aliens will be used', Color(0, 1, 1))
    end
end

function takeAT(box, expansion)
    if AT_PILE_GUID[expansion] == nil then
        return
    end
    for alert_color, guids in pairs(AT_PILE_GUID[expansion]) do
        local y_bounds = 0.05
        local alien_params = nil
        local flare_params = nil
        if alert_color == 'green' then
            alien_params = GREEN_ALIEN_PARAMS
            flare_params = GREEN_FLARE_PARAMS
            alien_pile = getPrimaryPile('Green', 'Aliens')
            flare_pile = getPrimaryPile('Green', 'Flares')
        elseif alert_color == 'yellow' then
            alien_params = YELLOW_ALIEN_PARAMS
            flare_params = YELLOW_FLARE_PARAMS
            alien_pile = getPrimaryPile('Yellow', 'Aliens')
            flare_pile = getPrimaryPile('Yellow', 'Flares')
        elseif alert_color == 'red' then
            alien_params = RED_ALIEN_PARAMS
            flare_params = RED_FLARE_PARAMS
            alien_pile = getPrimaryPile('Red', 'Aliens')
            flare_pile = getPrimaryPile('Red', 'Flares')
        else
            return nil
        end
        -- AT aliens
        local objects_to_take = {}

        -- take AT, aliens, or both?
        if ATstate == 0 then
            objects_to_take = { { aliens = guids.AT_Alien, flares = guids.AT_Flare } }
        elseif ATstate == 1 then
            objects_to_take = { { aliens = guids.AT_Alien, flares = guids.AT_Flare } }
        else
            objects_to_take = {
                { aliens = guids.AT_Alien, flares = guids.AT_Flare },
                { aliens = guids.AT_Alien, flares = guids.AT_Flare }
            }
        end

        for _, items in ipairs(objects_to_take) do
            y_bounds =
                math.max(
                    y_bounds,
                    takeAndPut(
                        box,
                        {
                            position = Vector(alien_params.position.x, y_offset, alien_params.position.z),
                            rotation = setupCardRotation,
                            smooth = false,
                            guid = items.aliens
                        },
                        alien_pile
                    ),
                    takeAndPut(
                        box,
                        {
                            position = Vector(flare_params.position.x, y_offset, flare_params.position.z),
                            rotation = setupCardRotation,
                            smooth = false,
                            guid = items.flares
                        },
                        flare_pile
                    )
                )
        end

        y_offset = y_offset + y_bounds
    end
end

ObjectStates.Description:
These bottles are used to add or deal homebrew aliens/flares.

Each card should be named and each deck should have a pair.

Place each deck into the bottles. Prepare the decks with the button.

Deal with the blue button. Should also work when other expansions are selected.
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
local Vector = Vector
local Color = Color
local getObjectFromGUID = getObjectFromGUID
local broadcastToAll = broadcastToAll
function onLoad()
    self.createButton(
        {
            click_function = 'Alpha',
            label = '',
            function_owner = self,
            position = Vector(0.55, 0, 1.75),
            rotation = Vector(0, 0, 0),
            tooltip = 'Prepares personal Aliens and Flares for dealing.\nPlace your custom decks into the bottles.',
            width = 300,
            height = 700,
            font_size = 10,
            color = Color(1, 1, 0.75)
        }
    )

    self.createButton(
        {
            click_function = 'Homebrew',
            label = '',
            function_owner = self,
            position = Vector(1.8, 0, 1.75),
            rotation = Vector(0, 0, 0),
            tooltip = 'Deal Aliens and Flares from inside the bottle.\nSetup instructions in its description.',
            width = 700,
            height = 700,
            font_size = 10,
            color = Color(0, 0.5, 1)
        }
    )

    self.createButton(
        {
            click_function = 'decreaseD',
            label = '',
            function_owner = Global,
            position = Vector(3, 0, 2.05),
            rotation = Vector(0, 0, 0),
            tooltip = 'Decrease dealt Aliens & Flares',
            width = 300,
            height = 300,
            font_size = 10,
            color = Color(0.5, 0, 0.5)
        }
    )

    self.createButton(
        {
            click_function = 'increaseD',
            label = '',
            function_owner = Global,
            position = Vector(3, 0, 1.45),
            rotation = Vector(0, 0, 0),
            tooltip = 'Increase dealt Aliens & Flares',
            width = 300,
            height = 300,
            font_size = 10,
            color = Color(0.5, 0, 0.5)
        }
    )

    self.createButton(
        {
            click_function = 'cycleAT',
            label = '',
            function_owner = getObjectFromGUID('b3ad93'),
            position = Vector(-3, 0, 1.75),
            rotation = Vector(0, 0, 0),
            tooltip =
            'Cycle whether Alternate Timeline aliens, Classic aliens, or both are used when selecting expansions.  Can be changed between each expansions for fine-grained control.',
            width = 300,
            height = 700,
            font_size = 10,
            color = Color(1, 0, 1)
        }
    )

    self.createButton(
        {
            click_function = 'smallflare',
            label = '',
            function_owner = self,
            position = Vector(-2.1, 0, 1.75),
            rotation = Vector(0, 0, 0),
            tooltip = 'Toggle adding random flares to the deck for less than 5 players.',
            width = 300,
            height = 700,
            font_size = 10,
            color = Color(0.25, 0.25, 0.25)
        }
    )

    self.createButton(
        {
            click_function = 'bigdeck',
            label = '',
            function_owner = self,
            position = Vector(-1.2, 0, 1.75),
            rotation = Vector(0, 0, 0),
            tooltip = 'Toggle adding extra cosmic cards for more than 6 players.',
            width = 300,
            height = 700,
            font_size = 10,
            color = Color(0.25, 0.25, 0.25)
        }
    )

    redt_count = 2
    sflare = true
    bdeck = true
end

function Alpha()
    -- Check the number of objects in the bag
    local potionamount = self.getQuantity()

    -- Broadcast message when number of decks is not 0 or 2
    if potionamount ~= 0 and potionamount ~= 2 then
        broadcastToAll('There should ideally be an Alien and Flare deck inside. Will process anyways.', Color(1, 0, 1))
    end

    -- If no decks found, broadcast a message and end the function
    if potionamount == 0 then
        broadcastToAll('No decks found in bottles', Color(1, 0, 1))
        return
    end

    -- Broadcast initial message and start the process
    broadcastToAll('Please wait... Decks are being processed...', Color(0, 1, 1))

    -- Define the delays for each step
    local delayMoveFromBag = 3
    local delaySortCardsClick = 1
    local delayMoveDeckToBag = 7

    -- Step 1: Reorder the deck size
    self.call('ReorderSize')

    -- Initialize deck quantities
    local deck1, deck2

    -- Loop through the process for each deck in the bag
    for i = 1, potionamount do
        -- Calculate the cumulative delays for each loop
        local cumulativeDelay = (i - 1) * (delayMoveFromBag + delaySortCardsClick + delayMoveDeckToBag)

        -- Step 2: Move the deck from the bag
        Wait.time(
            function()
                local topObject = self.takeObject({ index = 0, position = Vector(0, 0, 0) })
                if topObject then
                    topObject.setPosition(Vector(-103.44, 9.26, -21.08))
                    topObject.setRotation(Vector(0, 90.0, 0))
                    if i == 1 then
                        deck1 = topObject.getQuantity()
                    else
                        deck2 = topObject.getQuantity()
                    end
                else
                    print('No object found in the bag.')
                end
            end,
            cumulativeDelay + delayMoveFromBag
        )

        -- Step 3: Sort the cards in the deck
        Wait.time(
            function()
                getObjectFromGUID('b6c839').call('sortCardsClick')
                broadcastToAll('Please wait longer...', Color(0, 1, 1))
            end,
            cumulativeDelay + delayMoveFromBag + delaySortCardsClick
        )

        -- Step 4: Move the sorted deck to the bag
        Wait.time(
            function()
                getObjectFromGUID('b6c839').call('moveDeckToBag')
            end,
            cumulativeDelay + delayMoveFromBag + delaySortCardsClick + delayMoveDeckToBag
        )
    end

    -- Wait for the last deck to finish moving
    Wait.time(
        function()
            -- Print deck quantities for debugging
            --print(deck1)
            --print(deck2)

            -- Broadcast the final message
            if potionamount == 2 and deck1 == deck2 then
                self.call('Done')
            else
                self.call('PartiallyDone')
            end
        end,
        potionamount * (delayMoveFromBag + delaySortCardsClick + delayMoveDeckToBag) + 1
    )
end

function ReorderSize()
    local loopCount = 0

    function RecursiveReorderSize()
        loopCount = loopCount + 1

        if loopCount > 2 then
            --print("Ending ReorderSize after 2 loops.")
            return
        end

        local topObject = self.takeObject({ index = 0, position = Vector(0, 0, 0) })
        if topObject then
            topObject.setPosition(Vector(-109.90, 10.10, -29.34))
            topObject.setRotation(Vector(0, 90.0, 0))
            local size = topObject.getBounds().size.z
            --print("Top object size (z-axis): " .. size)
            if size > 3 then
                Wait.time(RecursiveReorderSize, 1)
            end
        else
            print('No object found in the bag.')
        end
    end

    RecursiveReorderSize()
end

function Done()
    broadcastToAll('Aliens and Flares have been alphabetized and are ready to deal!', Color(0, 1, 1))
end

function PartiallyDone()
    broadcastToAll(
        'Decks have been alphabetized but might not be ready to deal. Requires an Alien and Flare deck of equal quantity!',
        Color(1, 0, 1)
    )
end

function Homebrew()
    if getObjectFromGUID('b3ad93') then
        -- Check if the dealer is locked
        if getObjectFromGUID('b3ad93').getValue('lockDealing') then return end
    end
    self.call('ReorderSize')
    Wait.time(Homebrew_Continue, 3)
end

function Homebrew_Continue()
    --if getObjectFromGUID('b3ad93') then
    --    getObjectFromGUID('b3ad93').call('increaseD')
    --end

    params = {}
    Potion = getObjectFromGUID('5136d9')
    if Potion.getQuantity() ~= 2 then
        broadcastToAll('Need to add extactly one Alien deck with one Flare deck into these bottles!', Color(0, 1, 1))
        return
    end

    print('Dealing aliens and flares from homebrew selection into hands.')

    params.position = Vector(-103.50, 9, -23.00)
    params.index = 0
    params.rotation = Vector(0.00, 90.00, 180.00)
    params.smooth = false
    Aliens = Potion.takeObject(params)
    local base1 = Aliens.getQuantity()

    params.position = Vector(-103.50, 9, -19.00)
    params.index = 0
    params.rotation = Vector(0.00, 90.00, 180.00)
    params.smooth = false
    Flares = Potion.takeObject(params)
    local base2 = Flares.getQuantity()
    --print(base2)
    local seats = Global.call('count_confirmed_players')
    if seats < 5 and sflare == true then
        enoughflares = (5 - seats) * 2
    else
        enoughflares = 0
    end

    local enough = seats * Global.getVar('DealCount') + enoughflares
    if base1 < enough then
        broadcastToAll('Too few aliens. Not enough to distribute to all seated players.', Color(1, 0, 1))
        return
    elseif base1 == base2 then
        --calculate deck total
        --prepare expansion cards if there
        local expansiontotal = 0
        local dealer = getObjectFromGUID('b3ad93')
        if dealer ~= nil and not dealer.isDestroyed() then
            aliens, flares = getObjectFromGUID('b3ad93').call('HB', {aliens=Aliens, flares=Flares})
        else
            Wait.time(Deal, 2)
        end

        broadcastToAll('Please select your alien and mix appropriate flares into Cosmic Deck.', Color(0, 1, 1))
    else
        broadcastToAll('Decks are uneven, try again', Color(1, 0, 1))
        return
    end
end

function smallflare()
    if sflare == true then
        sflare = false
        broadcastToAll('Random Flares will NOT be mixed into the deck if less than 5 people', Color(0, 1, 1))
        if getObjectFromGUID('b3ad93') then
            getObjectFromGUID('b3ad93').call('noflare')
        end
    elseif sflare == false then
        sflare = true
        broadcastToAll('Random Flares will be ADDED to the deck if less than 5 people', Color(0, 1, 1))
        if getObjectFromGUID('b3ad93') then
            getObjectFromGUID('b3ad93').call('yesflare')
        end
    end
end

function bigdeck()
    if bdeck == true then
        bdeck = false
        broadcastToAll(
            'Extra Cosmic deck cards with NOT be added to the cosmic deck if more than 6 players',
            Color(0, 1, 1)
        )
        if getObjectFromGUID('b3ad93') then
            getObjectFromGUID('b3ad93').call('nomany')
        end
    elseif bdeck == false then
        bdeck = true
        broadcastToAll(
            'Extra Cosmic deck cards will be ADDED to the cosmic deck if more than 6 players',
            Color(0, 1, 1)
        )
        if getObjectFromGUID('b3ad93') then
            getObjectFromGUID('b3ad93').call('yesmany')
        end
    end
end

local function dealToPlayer(color, dealParams)
    if not Player[color].seated or getObjectFromGUID(dealParams.guid) then return end
    local params = { position = dealParams.position, rotation = dealParams.rotation, index = math.random(0, i), smooth = false }
    Aliens.takeObject(params).deal(1, dealParams.color)
    Flares.takeObject(params).deal(1, dealParams.color)
    --		print (params.index)
    i = i - 1
    playerSelector = getObjectFromGUID(params.color)
    if playerSelector then
        playerSelector.call('Move')
    end
end

function Deal()
    playerDealer = Global.getTable('PlayerDealerParams')
    local seats = Global.call('count_seated_players')
    if seats < 3 then
        broadcastToAll(
            'Requires at least 3 players to play! (found ' ..
            seats .. '). Continue testing or please reload game and try again.',
            Color(1, 0, 1)
        )
    end

    for _ = 1,Global.getVar('DealCount') do
        for color, Player in pairs(playerDealer) do
            dealToPlayer(playerDealer[color])
        end
    end

    if seats > 6 and bdeck then
        alliancedeck = getObjectFromGUID('3d4e8f')
        if alliancedeck then
            alliancedeck.call('Move')
        end
    end

    broadcastToAll(
        'Select your alien(s) by placing it on your tile. Throw any unused aliens and flares off the table. Mix your two flares into the deck and follow any "Game Setup" aliens before starting!',
        Color(0, 1, 1)
    )

    Wait.time(reset, 0.25)
    Wait.time(shufz, 1)
end

function reset()
    if getObjectFromGUID('b3ad93') then
        getObjectFromGUID('b3ad93').call('reset')
    end
end

function shufz()
    if Aliens then
        Aliens.shuffle()
    end
    if Flares then
        Flares.shuffle()
    end
    Cosmic = getObjectFromGUID('f6663d')
    if Cosmic then
        Cosmic.shuffle()
    end

    if sflare == true then
        Wait.time(function() flarez(5) end, 1)
    end
end

function shuffle()
    if Aliens then
        Aliens.shuffle()
    end
    if Flares then
        Flares.shuffle()
    end
    Cosmic = getObjectFromGUID('f6663d')
    if Cosmic then
        Cosmic.shuffle()
    end
end

function flarez(seated)
    if Flares then
        if seated < 5 then
            seatflare = (5 - seated) * 2
            while seatflare > 0 do
                local params = {}
                params.position = Vector(-8.33, 4, 2.06)
                params.rotation = Vector(0.00, 210.0, 180.00)
                params.smooth = false
                params.index = 0
                Flares.takeObject(params)
                seatflare = seatflare - 1
            end
            print('Random flares are selected and mixed into the Cosmic Deck for small game.')
            Wait.time(shuffle, 1)
        end
    else
        print('Flare deck not found to.  Please manually add the extra random flares to the to deck.')
    end
end

local Vector = Vector
deck = {}
cardsToSort = {}
size = 0
mustOrderByDescription = false

function onLoad()
    self.interactable = false
end

function onUpdate()
end

function sortCardsClick()
    deck = getDeck()
    if deck == nil then
        broadcastToAll('No deck found on the center of the large Aliens and Flares tile!', Color(0, 1, 1))
        return
    end
    splitCardsFromDeck()

    if mustOrderByDescription then
        table.sort(
            cardsToSort,
            function(a, b)
                return a.getDescription() .. a.getName() < b.getDescription() .. b.getName()
            end
        )
    else
        table.sort(
            cardsToSort,
            function(a, b)
                return a.getName() .. a.getDescription() < b.getName() .. b.getDescription()
            end
        )
    end
    makeNewDeck()
    Wait.condition(fillNewDeck, findNewDeck, 3, timeOut)
end

function orderByDescriptionCheckBox()
    mustOrderByDescription = not mustOrderByDescription
end

function getDeck()
    --local collisions = getCastCollisionToFindDeck({ self.getPosition().x - 1.5, self.getPosition().y + 10, self.getPosition().z })
    local collisions =
        getCastCollisionToFindDeck({self.getPosition().x, self.getPosition().y + 10, self.getPosition().z})
    for i, v in ipairs(collisions) do
        if (v.hit_object.tag == 'Deck') then
            return v.hit_object
        end
    end
    return nil
end



function getLastCard()
    --local collisions = getCastCollisionToFindDeck({ self.getPosition().x - 1.5, self.getPosition().y + 10, self.getPosition().z })
    local collisions =
        getCastCollisionToFindDeck({self.getPosition().x, self.getPosition().y + 10, self.getPosition().z})
    for i, v in ipairs(collisions) do
        if (v.hit_object.tag == 'Card') then
            return v.hit_object
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function getCastCollisionToFindDeck(position)
    local collisions =
        Physics.cast(
        {
            origin = position,
            direction = Vector(0, 1, 0),
            type = 3,
            size = Vector(self.getScale().x / 4, self.getScale().y * 100, self.getScale().z / 2),
            max_distance = 0
            --debug        = true,
        }
    )
    return collisions
end

function splitCardsFromDeck()
    local cards = deck.getObjects()
    size = #cards
    cardsToSort = {}
    for i in pairs(cards) do
        local card = {}
        if (i ~= size) then
            local params = {}
            params.position = Vector(deck.getPosition().x, deck.getPosition().y, deck.getPosition().z)
            card = deck.takeObject(params)
        else
            card = getLastCard()
        end
        --card.setPosition(Vector(card.getPosition().x, math.floor(card.getPosition().y + i + 200) / 100, card.getPosition().z))
        card.setPosition(
            Vector(card.getPosition().x, math.floor(card.getPosition().y - i - 1500) / 100, card.getPosition().z)
        )
        table.insert(cardsToSort, card)
        card.setLock(true)
    end
end

function makeNewDeck()
    local card1 = cardsToSort[1]
    card1.setLock(false)
    card1.setPosition(Vector(card1.getPosition().x, 17, card1.getPosition().z))
    local card2 = cardsToSort[2]
    card2.setLock(false)
    card2.setPosition(Vector(card2.getPosition().x, 18, card2.getPosition().z))
end

function fillNewDeck()
    for i, v in ipairs(cardsToSort) do
        if (i > 2) then
            Wait.condition(
                function()
                    --v.setPosition(Vector(deck.getPosition().x, deck.getPosition().y + 5, deck.getPosition().z))
                    v.setPosition(Vector(deck.getPosition().x, deck.getPosition().y + 15, deck.getPosition().z))
                    v.setLock(false)
                    deck.putObject(v)
                end,
                function()
                    local lastCard = cardsToSort[i - 1]
                    if lastCard == nil then
                        return true
                    elseif
                        lastCard.getPosition().x == deck.getPosition().x and
                            lastCard.getPosition().y < deck.getPosition().y + 14.75 and --default was 4.75 and was extremely slow! This speeds it up significantly!
                            lastCard.getPosition().z == deck.getPosition().z
                     then
                        return true
                    end
                    return false
                end
            )
        end
    end
end

function findNewDeck()
    deck = {}
    local collisions =
        getCastCollisionToFindDeck(Vector(self.getPosition().x, self.getPosition().y + 10, self.getPosition().z))
    for i, v in ipairs(collisions) do
        if (v.hit_object.tag == 'Deck' and #v.hit_object.getObjects() == 2) then
            deck = v.hit_object
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function moveDeckToBag()
  local bagPosition = Vector(-109.90, 10.10, -29.34) -- Bag position
    -- Move the deck object to the bag's position
    deck.setPosition(bagPosition)
end

function timeOut()
    print('Time-out!')
end

local Vector = Vector
local Color = Color
local tryPrintToColor = tryPrintToColor
local time = Wait.time
local getObjectFromGUID = getObjectFromGUID
local printToAll = printToAll
self.createButton(
    {

self.createButton(

function onLoad()
    --toggles for if aliens are placed.
    doingSetup = {

        Yellow = false,

        Red = false,

    --aliens

    }

    }

    --check deck and alien variables
    extraStations = 0

function dealAll()
    local params = {smooth = false}

    --checks if aliens were dealt
    if (not Global.getVar('dealingComplete')) and (Global.getVar('DealCount') ~= 0) and getObjectFromGUID('b3ad93') ~= nil then
        broadcastToAll(
            'Please select expansions, aliens and variants before starting. Selections are on the other table!',
            Color(0, 1, 1)
        )
        printToAll('Hint: You can bypass the auto dealer by using the purple buttons to decrease the count to 0. ' ..
        'This will allow automatic game setup to proceed if the expansion dealer isn\'t working for some reason.', Color(0, 1, 1))
    else
        --checks if all players selected an alien
        --print ('Moving on...')
        local tilecheck = false
        local colorsNotSelected = {}
        local colorsNotSelected2 = {}

        local function checkAlienSelected(color, playerPlacerGUID, alienTileGUID, alienTile2GUID)
            if (Player[color].seated or getObjectFromGUID(playerPlacerGUID) == nil) then
                if not (alienTiles[color]) and getObjectFromGUID(alienTileGUID) then
                    colorsNotSelected[color] = true
                    tilecheck = true
                end
                if not getObjectFromGUID('dc6d2b') and not (alienTiles2[color]) and getObjectFromGUID(alienTile2GUID) then
                    -- log("Color2: " .. color)
                    colorsNotSelected2[color] = true
                    tilecheck = true
                end
            end
        end

        checkAlienSelected('White', '3da734', '00a2b6', '36205f')
        checkAlienSelected('Pink', 'b3f5a1', '1febcc', 'd65369')
        checkAlienSelected('Orange', '167261', 'fc06db', '3507b8')
        checkAlienSelected('Red', 'af52f3', '6f772a', '310160')
        checkAlienSelected('Blue', 'be7ab6', '90e3da', '248ec2')
        checkAlienSelected('Yellow', '0fe968', '2b3315', '8d6760')
        checkAlienSelected('Purple', '13259b', '6962ad', 'b21219')
        checkAlienSelected('Green', '5863b6', '74b859', 'fc6e2a')

        if tilecheck then
            broadcastToAll(
                "All players need to place their alien on their tile! See game chat for a list of who hasn't selected yet.",
                Color(0, 1, 1)
            )
            for color, _ in pairs(colorsNotSelected) do
                printToAll(color .. ' has not placed their alien', color)
            end
            if not getObjectFromGUID('dc6d2b') then
                for color2, _ in pairs(colorsNotSelected2) do
                    printToAll(color2 .. ' has not placed their second alien', color2)
                end
            end
        else
            --checks if hands are empty
            empty = false
            for _, color in ipairs({'White', 'Green', 'Purple', 'Yellow', 'Blue', 'Red', 'Orange', 'Pink'}) do
                for _, object in ipairs(Player[color].getHandObjects(1)) do
                    empty = empty or (object ~= nil and not aristocrat[color])
                end
                log("Found", nil, "setup")
            end

            if empty then
                broadcastToAll(
                    'Please empty hands. Rejected aliens can be sent to the void by throwing them off the table!',
                    Color(0, 1, 1)
                )
            else
                -- deal out all cards!
                -- deck needs to not be local since it is used in the shuffle function
                deck = getObjectFromGUID('f6663d')
                if deck then
                    deck.shuffle()
                    for color, guid in pairs(
                        {
                            White = '3da734',
                            Pink = 'b3f5a1',
                            Orange = '167261',
                            Red = 'af52f3',
                            Blue = 'be7ab6',
                            Yellow = '0fe968',
                            Purple = '13259b',
                            Green = '5863b6'
                        }
                    ) do
                        if Player[color].seated or getObjectFromGUID(guid) == nil then
                            if glutton[color] then
                                deck.deal(10, color)
                            elseif oligarch[color] then
                                deck.deal(9, color)
                            elseif throwback[color] then
                                deck.deal(7, color)
                            elseif aristocrat[color] then
                                -- aristocrat gets no cards
                            elseif miser[color] then
                                deck.deal(8, color)
                                for _ = 1, 8 do
                                    if color == "White" or color == "Orange" or color == "Blue" or color == "Purple" then
                                        deck.dealToColorWithOffset({-10.5, 1, 0}, false, color)
                                    else
                                        deck.dealToColorWithOffset({10.5, 1, 0}, false, color)
                                    end
                                end
                            else
                                deck.deal(8, color)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                else
                    printToAll('Original Cosmic Deck not found. Please deal cards from Cosmic Deck manually.', 'Red')
                end

                --alien setup
                if getObjectFromGUID('689328') and infernocards then
                    local params = {smooth = false, position = Vector(-8.33, 4, 2.06), rotation = Vector(0, 210, 180)}
                    for _ = 1, 5 do
                        getObjectFromGUID('689328').takeObject(params)
                    end
                    printToAll('[INFO] Infero Flares have been added to the cosmic deck.', Color(0, 1, 1))
                    time(shuffle, 1)
                end

                --deck check

                if not getObjectFromGUID('89c117') then
                    time(techdeal, 0.5)
                end

                if not getObjectFromGUID('c60837') then
                    time(stationdeal, 1)
                end

                if not getObjectFromGUID('fa97cd') then
                    time(stardeal, 1.5)
                end

                if not getObjectFromGUID('ee3558') then
                    time(moondeal, 2)
                end

                if not getObjectFromGUID('eedeaf') then
                    time(luxdeal, 2.5)
                end

                if not getObjectFromGUID('41bfca') then
                    time(evodeal, 3)
                end

                time(reset, 0.25)
            end
        end
    end
end

function techdeal()
    local techdeck = getObjectFromGUID('52a825')
    if techdeck then
        if extraTech then
            techdeck.deal(3)
        else
            techdeck.deal(2)
        end
    else
        printToAll('Original Tech Deck not found. Please deal 2 cards from Tech Deck manually.', 'Red')
    end
end

function stationdeal()
    log("Dealing Stations", nil, "setup")
    local stationdeck = getObjectFromGUID('973f84')
    local deepstation = getObjectFromGUID('bc55bc')
    local skycities = getObjectFromGUID('ed6255')
    if stationdeck then
        if extraStations == 1 then

local Vector = Vector
local getObjectFromGUID = getObjectFromGUID
local broadcastToAll = broadcastToAll

function onload(save_state)
    self.interactable = false

    --button
    self.createButton(
        {
            click_function = 'Cycle',
            label = '',
            function_owner = self,
            position = Vector(0, 1.45, 1.45),
            rotation = Vector(0, 0, 0),
            tooltip = 'Cycle Hazard Warning announcements!\nDestiny Hazards\nExtremely Hazardous\nProcedural Change',
            width = 500,
            height = 200,
            font_size = 10,
            color = Color(1, 1, 0)
        }
    )

    zone = getObjectFromGUID('47b85b')
    zoneObjects = zone.getObjects()
    phase = 0

    token = getObjectFromGUID('a10b0d')
    token2 = getObjectFromGUID('573338')

    first_encounter = 1

    for k, v in pairs(zoneObjects) do
        --check if hazard token is in play after reload
        if v == token then
            self.call('hazardON')
        end
    end

    extremetoken = getObjectFromGUID('15af05')
    changetoken = getObjectFromGUID('637a1f')
    yellow = Vector(0, 240, 180)
    red = Vector(0, 240, 0)
end

function Cycle()
    --default
    local rgb = Color(0, 1, 1)
    if extremetoken.is_face_down and not changetoken.is_face_down then
        --extreme
        extremetoken.setRotation(yellow)
        changetoken.setRotation(yellow)
        broadcastToAll('Default Hazard Warning on Destiny Hazards', rgb)
    elseif extremetoken.is_face_down and changetoken.is_face_down then
        --change
        extremetoken.setRotation(red)
        changetoken.setRotation(yellow)
        broadcastToAll('Every encounter is a Hazard Warning!', rgb)
    elseif not extremetoken.is_face_down and changetoken.is_face_down then
        extremetoken.setRotation(yellow)
        changetoken.setRotation(red)
        broadcastToAll('Every second and additional encounters are Hazard Warnings!', rgb)
    end
end

--hazard main checks and logic
function onObjectEnterScriptingZone(zone, obj)
    if zone == getObjectFromGUID('47b85b') then
        if obj.getGUID() == nil then
            return
        else
            if obj == token then
                self.call('hazardON')
            end

            if obj.getDescription() == 'Destiny' then
                if obj.is_face_down == false then
                    if i == 1 then
                        --default destiny hazards
                        if extremetoken.is_face_down and changetoken.is_face_down then
                            --checks if procedural change is in play, if the turn/phase button is used, and has a timer so a hazard is announced if forgotten.
                            if obj.getName() == 'White Destiny Hazard' then
                                self.call('hazardactive')
                            end

                            if obj.getName() == 'Green Destiny Hazard' then
                                self.call('hazardactive')
                            end

                            if obj.getName() == 'Purple Destiny Hazard' then
                                self.call('hazardactive')
                            end

                            if obj.getName() == 'Yellow Destiny Hazard' then
                                self.call('hazardactive')
                            end

                            if obj.getName() == 'Blue Destiny Hazard' then
                                self.call('hazardactive')
                            end

                            if obj.getName() == 'Red Destiny Hazard' then
                                self.call('hazardactive')
                            end

                            if obj.getName() == 'Orange Destiny Hazard' then
                                self.call('hazardactive')
                            end

                            if obj.getName() == 'Pink Destiny Hazard' then
                                self.call('hazardactive')
                            end

                            if obj.getName() == 'Invasion! Hazard' then
                                self.call('hazardactive')
                            end
                        elseif extremetoken.is_face_down and not changetoken.is_face_down then
                            --checks if extreme hazardous is in play, if the turn/phase button is used, and has a timer so a hazard is announced if forgotten.
                            if first_encounter == 1 then
                                Wait.time(next_destiny, 60)
                            else
                                self.call('hazardactive')
                            end
                        elseif not extremetoken.is_face_down and changetoken.is_face_down then
                            self.call('hazardactive')
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    else
        return
    end
end

function onObjectLeaveScriptingZone(zone, obj)
    if zone == getObjectFromGUID('47b85b') then
        if obj.getGUID() == nil then
            return
        else
            if obj == token then
                i = 0
            end

            if obj.getDescription() == 'Destiny' then
                if obj.is_face_down == false then
                    if extremetoken.is_face_down and changetoken.is_face_down then
                        if phase ~= 1 then
                            if i == 1 then
                                if obj.getName() == 'White Destiny Hazard' then
                                    self.call('hazarddeactive')
                                end

                                if obj.getName() == 'Green Destiny Hazard' then
                                    self.call('hazarddeactive')
                                end

                                if obj.getName() == 'Purple Destiny Hazard' then
                                    self.call('hazarddeactive')
                                end

                                if obj.getName() == 'Yellow Destiny Hazard' then
                                    self.call('hazarddeactive')
                                end

                                if obj.getName() == 'Blue Destiny Hazard' then
                                    self.call('hazarddeactive')
                                end

                                if obj.getName() == 'Red Destiny Hazard' then
                                    self.call('hazarddeactive')
                                end

                                if obj.getName() == 'Orange Destiny Hazard' then
                                    self.call('hazarddeactive')
                                end

                                if obj.getName() == 'Pink Destiny Hazard' then
                                    self.call('hazarddeactive')
                                end

                                if obj.getName() == 'Invasion! Hazard' then
                                    self.call('hazarddeactive')
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    else
        return
    end
end

--flips tokens
function hazardactive()
    broadcastToAll('HAZARD WARNING', Color(0, 1, 1))
    token.setRotation(Vector(0.00, 270.00, 0.00))
    token2.setRotation(Vector(0.00, 270.00, 0.00))
end

function hazarddeactive()
    token.setRotation(Vector(0.00, 270.00, 180.00))
    token2.setRotation(Vector(0.00, 270.00, 180.00))
end

--moves hazard tokens
function hazardON()
    i = 1
    token.setPosition(Vector(12.15, 1.02, -0.33))
    token.setLock(true)
    token2.setPosition(Vector(-11.79, 1.02, -0.42))
    token2.setLock(true)
end

--sets variabls
function next_destiny()
    first_encounter = 0
end

function reset_destiny()
    first_encounter = 1
end

function phase_used()
    phase = 1
end

function phase_reset()
    phase = 0
end

function onload()
    self.createButton(
        {
            click_function = 'PrintRandomOrder',
            label = 'Random\nFirst\nPlayer',
            tooltip = 'Select random first player',
            function_owner = self,
            position = Vector(0, 0.18, 0),
            rotation = Vector(0, 0, 0),
            width = 1000,
            height = 1000,
            font_size = 200
        }
    )
end

function PrintRandomOrder()
    local function BBcolor(stringColor)
        local color = stringColorToRGB(stringColor)
        return '[' .. string.format('%02x%02x%02x', color[1] * 255, color[2] * 255, color[3] * 255) .. ']'
    end

    clickCount = clickCount or 1
    local seated = getSeatedPlayers()
    local shuffled = {}
    while #seated > 0 do
        local rand = math.random(1, #seated)
        table.insert(shuffled, table.remove(seated, rand))
    end
    --local msg = '(#' .. clickCount .. ') ' .. Player[clickPlayerColor].steam_name .. ' (' .. Player[clickPlayerColor].color .. ') '
    local msg = 'no'
    msg = msg .. 'determines the random player order to be: '
    for k, color in ipairs(shuffled) do
        msg = msg .. BBcolor(color) .. Player[color].steam_name .. ' (' .. color .. '), [-]'
        --print('' .. color .. ' [-]')
        first = '' .. color .. ''
        --print(first)
    end
    msg = msg:sub(1, -6)
    --broadcastToAll(msg, Color(1, 1, 1))

    Turns.turn_color = first
    --print(first)
    Turns.enable = true

    clickCount = clickCount + 1
end

    --yellow

    ship = getObjectFromGUID('f66a39')

    if getObjectFromGUID('e8b458') then

    --blue

    ship = getObjectFromGUID('ff817e')

--COLOUR SHUFFLER SCRIPT
--DEVELOPED BY MARKIMUS ON STEAM

local Vector = Vector
local getSeatedPlayers = getSeatedPlayers
adminOnlyButton = false
selectColour = Color(0.3, 1, 0.3)
textColour = Color(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)

function onLoad()
    local buttonParams = {}
    buttonParams.function_owner = self
    buttonParams.click_function = 'shufflePlayers'
    --buttonParams.label = "Shuffle\nPlayers"
    buttonParams.width = 700
    buttonParams.height = 700
    buttonParams.font_size = 300
    buttonParams.position = Vector(0, 0, 0)
    buttonParams.tooltip = 'Shuffle Seated Players\nUSE BEFORE DEALING ALIENS'
    self:createButton(buttonParams)
end

function shuffleTable(tab)
    --print("Shuffle Table called.")
    for i = 1, #tab * 2 do
        local a = math.random(#tab)
        local b = math.random(#tab)
        tab[a], tab[b] = tab[b], tab[a]
    end
    return tab
end

shufflePlayersDebounce = false

function shufflePlayers(object, colour)
    if shufflePlayersDebounce == true then
        return
    end
    if adminOnlyButton == true and Player[colour].admin == false then
        return
    end
    if #getSeatedPlayers() < 2 then
        printToAll(
            'Shuffle Players: [808080]' ..
                Player[colour].steam_name .. ', there must be more than one player for shuffling to work.',
            textColour
        )
        return
    end
    if Player['Black'].seated == true then
        printToAll('Please remove Player Black for shuffling to work.', textColour)
        return
    end
    shufflePlayersDebounce = true

    local deselectColour = self:getColorTint()

    self:setColorTint(selectColour)

    printToAll('Shuffle Players: ' .. Player[colour].steam_name .. ' initiated shuffling.', textColour)

    local ranColours = {}

    --INSERT THE COLOURS

    for _, v in pairs(getSeatedPlayers()) do
        table.insert(ranColours, v)
    end

    shuffleTable(ranColours)

    local seatedPlayers = {}
    for i, v in pairs(getSeatedPlayers()) do
        seatedPlayers[v] = {}
        seatedPlayers[v].target = ranColours[i]
        seatedPlayers[v].myColour = v
        --printToAll(Player[v].steam_name .. "(".. v ..") -> ".. ranColours[i], Color(1, 1, 1))
        if seatedPlayers[v].target == v then
            seatedPlayers[v].prevMoved = true
            seatedPlayers[v].moved = true
        else
            seatedPlayers[v].prevMoved = false
            seatedPlayers[v].moved = false
        end
    end

    --START SHUFFLING PLAYERS.

    function shuffleDelay()
        for timeout = 1, 50 do
            --GO THROUGH SEATED PLAYERS. IF THEY HAVEN'T MOVED, CHECK IF THEY CAN BE MOVED.
            for i, v in pairs(seatedPlayers) do
                --print("Test")
                if v.moved == false then
                    if Player[v.target].seated == false then
                        local myC = v.myColour
                        if Player[myC].seated == true then
                            --print("Moving player ".. myC)
                            Player[myC]:changeColor(v.target)
                            while Player[myC].seated == true and Player[v.target].seated == false do
                                coroutine.yield()
                            end
                            v.myColour = v.target
                            v.moved = true
                        else
                            table.remove(seatedPlayers, i)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            local checkIfSame = true
            for _, v in pairs(seatedPlayers) do
                if v.prevMoved ~= v.moved then
                    checkIfSame = false
                    break
                end
            end

            if checkIfSame == true then
                --print("Is same.")
                local allNonMovedPlayers = {}
                for i, v in pairs(seatedPlayers) do
                    if v.moved == false then
                        table.insert(allNonMovedPlayers, v)
                    end
                end

                if #allNonMovedPlayers ~= 0 then
                    local lastPlayer = allNonMovedPlayers[#allNonMovedPlayers]
                    Player[lastPlayer.myColour]:changeColor('Black')
                    lastPlayer.myColour = 'Black'
                    while Player['Black'].seated == false do
                        coroutine.yield()
                    end
                end
            end

            local count1, count2 = 0, 0

To use, place a card on this, then click the announce button.  If the card is face up, it will announce to all players that you wish to play the card.  If the card is face down, it will inform everyone that you wish to play some card, without specifying which one.
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
-- yellow card announcer
local Vector = Vector
local broadcastToAll = broadcastToAll
local broadcastToColor = broadcastToColor
local spawnObject = spawnObject
function onLoad(save_state)
    self.createButton(
        {
            click_function = 'announce',
            label = 'Announce',
            function_owner = self,
            position = Vector(0, self.getBoundsNormalized().size.y, self.getBoundsNormalized().size.z / 5),
            rotation = Vector(0, 0, 0),
            tooltip = 'Announce Card',
            width = 400,
            height = 100,
            font_size = 48,
            color = Color(199/255, 191/255, 37/255)
        }
    )
end

function broadcastCard(zone, color)
    if color ~= "Yellow" and color ~= "Black" and color ~= nil then 
        broadcastToColor("This is yellow's card announcer.  Use your own!", color)
    else
        local objs_in_zone = zone.getObjects()
        local did_broadcast = false -- For good UX, let user know when we did not detect any cards to announce
        for _,obj in pairs(zone.getObjects()) do
            if obj ~= nil and obj.type == "Card" then
                did_broadcast = true
                if obj.is_face_down then
                    broadcastToAll("[Announcement] Yellow wishes to play a card!")
                else
                    local name = obj.getName()
                    if name == nil or name == "" then
                        name = "a card"
                    end
                    broadcastToAll("[Announcement] Yellow is playing " .. name .. "!")
                end
                break
            elseif obj.type == "Deck" then
                local cards = obj.getObjects()
                if cards ~= nil and obj.is_face_down then
                    did_broadcast = true
                    broadcastToAll("[Announcement] Yellow wishes to play " .. #cards .. " card(s)!")
                elseif #cards > maxDeckCards then
                    did_broadcast = true
                    broadcastToColor("It's best not to announce more than " ..  maxDeckCards .. " cards at a time.  Try again with fewer cards or split it up into multiple announcements.", color)
                else
                    local num_unnamed_cards = 0
                    local msg = ""
                    for i,card in pairs(cards) do
                        local nick = card.nickname
                        if nick == nil or nick == "" then
                            num_unnamed_cards = num_unnamed_cards + 1
                        elseif i == #cards then
                            if num_unnamed_cards == (#cards - 1) then
                                msg = nick
                            else
                                msg = msg .. " and " .. nick
                            end
                            
                        elseif i <= 1 then
                            msg = nick
                        else
                            msg = msg .. ", " .. nick
                        end
                    end
                    did_broadcast = true
                    if num_unnamed_cards == #cards then
                        broadcastToAll("[Announcement] Yellow is playing " .. num_unnamed_cards .. " cards!", undefined)
                    elseif num_unnamed_cards == 1 then
                        broadcastToAll("[Announcement] Yellow is playing " .. msg .. " and " .. num_unnamed_cards .. " other card!")
                    elseif num_unnamed_cards > 1 then
                        broadcastToAll("[Announcement] Yellow is playing " .. msg .. " and " .. num_unnamed_cards .. " other cards!")
                    else
                        broadcastToAll("[Announcement] Yellow is playing " .. msg .. "!")
                    end
                end
                break
            end
            -- break -- stop after finding the first card
        end
        if not(did_broadcast) then
            broadcastToColor("Could not find any cards to broadcast.  Make sure the cards you wish to announce are on the tile and try again.", color)
        end
    end
    zone.destruct()
end
function announce(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    spawnObject({
        type              = "ScriptingTrigger",
        position          = obj.getPosition() + Vector(0, obj.getBoundsNormalized().size.y, 0),
        rotation          = obj.getRotation(),
        scale             = obj.getBoundsNormalized().size,
        callback_function = |z| broadcastCard(z, player_color),
    })

end

local Vector = Vector
    local Color = Color
    function onLoad()
    infoRefresh()
    buttonRefresh()
end

function onObjectLoopingEffect(obj)
    if obj == self then
        infoRefresh()
        buttonRefresh()
    end
end

function infoRefresh()
    loopID = self.AssetBundle.getLoopingEffectIndex()
    loopCount = 3
    indexPage = 1
    self.setName(ref_pageInfo[loopID+1].name)
    self.setDescription(ref_pageInfo[loopID+1].desc)
end

--Click functions

function click_next()
    infoRefresh()
    if loopID < loopCount then
        self.AssetBundle.playLoopingEffect(loopID + 1)
        buttonRefresh()
    end
end

function click_prev()
    infoRefresh()
    if loopID > 0 then
        self.AssetBundle.playLoopingEffect(loopID - 1)
        buttonRefresh()
    end
end

function click_index()
    infoRefresh()
    if indexPage ~= loopID then
        self.AssetBundle.playLoopingEffect(indexPage)
        buttonRefresh()
    end
end

function click_close()
    infoRefresh()
    self.AssetBundle.playLoopingEffect(0)
    buttonRefresh()
end

--Button creation

function buttonRefresh()
    self.clearButtons()
    infoRefresh()
    if loopID == 0 then
        createOpenButton()
    elseif loopID == indexPage then
        createNextButton()
        createCloseButton()
    elseif loopID == loopCount -1 then
        createPrevButton()
        createIndexButton()
        createCloseButton()
    elseif loopID < loopCount then
        createNextButton()
        createPrevButton()
        createIndexButton()
        createCloseButton()
    end
end


function createOpenButton()
    self.createButton({
        click_function="click_next", function_owner=self,
        position=Vector(-2.64,0.16,-1.475), height=100, width=100, color=Color(1,1,1,0)
    })
end

end

    self.createButton({
        click_function="click_prev", function_owner=self,
        position=Vector(2.655,0.16,-1.22), height=100, width=100, color=Color(1,1,1,0)
    })
end

function createIndexButton()
    self.createButton({
        click_function="click_index", function_owner=self,
        position=Vector(2.655,0.16,-1.475), height=100, width=100, color=Color(1,1,1,0)
    })
end

    self.createButton({

ObjectStates.Description:
Way of keeping track of the chaos during attack encounters.

Kicker*(Attack+Value Effects) +Ships+Added Reinforcements

Kickers simply multiply with the final attack value after other effects are finalized.
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
function onload(saved_data)

    vals = {}
    for i=0,34 do
        vals[tostring(i)] = ""
    end

    if saved_data ~= "" then
        vals = JSON.decode(saved_data)
    end

    createAll()
end

function updateSave()
    vals = {}
    for _,input in pairs(self.getInputs()) do
        if input.index <= 34 then
            vals[tostring(input.index)] = tostring(input.value)
        end
    end
local offense = 0
local defense = 0

    for r=1,2 do
        local row_total = 0
        local is_set = false
        local attack =0
        local effect =0
        local value =0  
        local kicker =0    

        for v=2,6 do
            if tonumber(vals[tostring(r*7-v)]) then
                is_set = true
                
                if v==4 then
                effect = tonumber(vals[tostring(r*7-v)])
                else

                if v==5 then
                 attack = tonumber(vals[tostring(r*7-v)])

                else
                if v==6 and tonumber(vals[tostring(r*7-v)]) then
                 kicker = tonumber(vals[tostring(r*7-v)])
                value= attack + effect
					row_total = row_total + value*kicker
                else
                row_total = row_total + tonumber(vals[tostring(r*7-v)])
                end
                end
                end
            end
        end
        if not is_set then
            row_total = ""
        else
            row_total = tostring(row_total)
            
            if r==1 then
                offense = row_total
            end
            if r==2 then
                 defense = row_total
            end
        end
        vals[tostring(r*7-1)] = row_total
        self.editInput({index=(r*7-1), value=row_total})
    end

    local pos = {}
    for p=0,1 do
        local v = tostring(p*7)
        local t = tostring(p*7+6)
        if vals[t] ~= "" then
            local ps = {v, 0}
            ps[2] = tonumber(vals[t])
            table.insert(pos, ps)
        else
            vals[v] = ""
            self.editInput({index=tonumber(v), value=""})
        end
    end


    --print(JSON.encode(vals))
    saved_data = JSON.encode(vals)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function comp_position(a,b)
    return a[2] > b[2]
end

function createAll()
    f_color = {0,0,0,100}

    for i=0,1 do

-- encounter
        self.createInput({
            value = vals[tostring(i*7 + 0)],
            input_function = "saveInput",
            tooltip="",
            label = "",
            function_owner = self,
            alignment = 2,
            tab = 2,
            position = {-2.5,0.1,0.1+(i*0.6)},

         -- kicker

        -- Ships

            })

        self.createInput({

    end
	
    --self.setName("")

    vals = ""
	self.call('removeAll')
	self.call('createAll')

	Wait.time(edit, 1)
